## Q187

Q187 (2026-10-01, owner: "an option to emphasize the motor nerve endpoints within muscles" / "define the motor
endpoints of specific muscle as the target to needle insertion") -- DATA only (the viewer UI is a parallel agent's).
PRIVATE clinical layer, never inside an anatomy bundle: `clinical/data/motor_points.json` (schema
`nmsk.motor_points.v1`, viewers vhm / vhf / zan_m = build/viewer_zan_atlas / zan_f = build/viewer_zan_female),
`clinical/LICENSE_PRIVATE.md`, rebuild `python3 scripts/clinical/motor_points_q187.py --jobs 4` (~20 min, reads the
published geometry: own bundles' JSON from the HTML + bundle.bin; Z-Anatomy manifest + geo_NN.txt), test
`tests/test_motor_points_q187.py` (schema, DOI+PMID on every point, every point inside its muscle mesh), coverage
`data/derived/Q187_motor_points_coverage.json` (per viewer: muscles, failed + not-placed with reasons, line lengths).
- Sources: 41 real studies, each verified on PubMed (DOI+PMID) -- Sihler / dissection / motor-point studies (Kwon 2009
  adductors, An 2010 + Rha 2016 hamstrings, Yi KH et al. 2016-2026 TA, gastrocnemius, soleus, VM, VL, sartorius,
  deltoid, triceps, trapezius, rhomboids, teres major, piriformis; Lee JH et al. biceps/brachialis, TP, fibularis, SCM;
  Zhou 2024 forearm flexors and Li 2021 pectorals (3-D CT-projected surface coordinates); Huang 2024 tibial-nerve
  entries; Park 2007, Amirali 2007, Oddy 2006, Choi 2023 TFL, Page 2019, Van Campenhout 2010, Caetano 2020, Xie 2012,
  Wang 2024, Kwon 2020, Lee 2022/2023) plus three Diaconu 2025 Toxins reviews only where no primary rule was found
  (rectus femoris, FDL, FHL, brachioradialis). Botter 2011 / Behringer 2014 (EMS motor-point atlases) could not be
  used: full text not reachable (egress blocked) and the abstracts give no numbers.
- Method: landmarks measured on each body's own bones (muscle-mesh ends only where the source's line is origin ->
  insertion); "level" rules -> cross-section of the muscle at that level (centroid, or the named head/third sector
  when the body has one mesh for a multi-head muscle); 2-D surface rules -> mid-muscle on the needle line; points
  pushed >= 1 mm inside the mesh; >5 mm from the rule = FAILED (listed, not forced). Uncertainty = the source's
  range half-width or SD on this body's line length (floor 5 mm for landmark finding); single-value rules +/-5%.
- Result: vhm 162 points / 50 muscles, vhf 154 / 51, zan_m 185 / 55, zan_f 188 / 56 (58 muscles in all; ~1/3 motor
  points, 2/3 innervation-zone centres); failed 19 / 10 / 17 / 14 (mostly Zhou forearm points -- pronated forearms --
  and Li pectoralis minor), uncertainty 5-105 mm (median ~17 mm; wide published zones give the large values).
  Depth from skin only in own bodies (Z-Anatomy has no skin: null).
- Not placed: SCM in own bodies (their SCM meshes stop 25-34 mm short of the skull, so the mastoid cannot be
  identified); deltoid etc. where a mesh is missing; no usable rule: latissimus dorsi (T5 not separable), gluteus
  maximus/medius, obturator internus, subscapularis, EHL, longus colli/capitis, adductor pollicis, FHB (reasons in
  the coverage file). Renders: scratchpad q187/q187_<viewer>_r.png (biceps, deltoid, gastrocnemius, TA, FCR, BF).
- [ ] Next: UI agent wires the json; owner to review the sector rule for single-mesh multi-head muscles (triceps,
  gastrocnemius, soleus, deltoid in own bodies) and decide whether review-sourced (Diaconu) points stay.

## Q188

Q188 (2026-10-01, owner requests 2-6: needle penetration in the Z-Anatomy viewers too; a 3-D needle
whose in-tissue part is "a bit less visible"; deep targets through a cutout or by direction + length;
motor points as targets; risk halos + safer pathways). A PRIVATE clinical needle add-on shared by all
four viewers. Not published (no artifact touched).

**Licensing layout.** Private (owner's clinical layer, `clinical/LICENSE_PRIVATE.md`, not CC BY-SA, not for
redistribution; it references the anatomy layer and contains no geometry): `clinical/needle_tool.js`,
`clinical/data/risk_{vhm,vhf,zan_m,zan_f}.json`, `clinical/data/motor_points.json` (Q187 agent),
`scripts/clinical/risk_structures_q188.py`, `scripts/clinical/stage_clinical_files.py`,
`tests/fixtures/q188_motor_points_fixture.json` (synthetic, labelled FIXTURE, never shipped). Anatomy layer
(CC BY-SA where Z-Anatomy-derived) keeps only a generic hook: `viewer/atlas_viewer.template.html` and
`viewer/zan_atlas.template.html` load `<script src="clinical_needle_tool.js">` if present and hand
`window.NMSKClinical.attach()` an anatomy API (list/visible/geometry/pick/ray/view/toScreen/cut/setCut/focus/
redraw/setOpacityOverride/categoryOn/setCategoryOn/setClickHandler/onChange/catColor + three.js scene objects,
or for the raw-WebGL Z-Anatomy page `webgl.onAfterDraw`/`drawStructure`). Without the file both pages are
plain atlases (verified: no needle button, 0 page errors). The old in-template needle tool (Q58) moved into the
add-on unchanged in behaviour; the "needle" button of the nerve course table only appears with the add-on.
General anatomy viewing added to the templates: a Cut plane (specimen viewers: new Cut tool -- sagittal/axial/
coronal/facing-me, movable, flip; Z-Anatomy: its existing cut gained "facing me"); picking ignores the removed half.
Z-Anatomy page keeps its quantised geometry in memory only when the add-on is present (CPU picking/rays).

**Features (clinical/needle_tool.js).** (1) 3-D needle: lit Phong steel shaft with an oblique bevel at the tip,
a tapered hub at the shaft start (hub sits `needle length - path length` outside the entry, at the entry in
direction mode), real geometry in the perspective scene (nearer = larger: measured 6.2 px vs 4.2 px radius for
the tip 160 mm vs entry 243 mm from the eye), the part beyond the entry drawn depth-tested plus a 30 % see-through
pass (no depth test) so it stays findable. (2) Modes: entry -> target (old behaviour; regression on the old
harness cases, vhm 3 + vhf 5: identical crossings/depths, length diff 7e-15 mm); entry + direction + length
(direction = inward skin normal tilted by tilt/azimuth degrees, or "use view axis"; length slider 5-200 mm;
the tip is the target and the report says what it lands in); target first (click a cut face -- a click whose
ray meets the cut plane before any surface and inside a structure picks the point ON the face; or a motor
point), then entry / "Shortest entry" / safer pathways. Plus "Zoom to target", "Cut through target" (view-facing
cut through the target). (3) Motor points: `clinical_motor_points.json` (schema nmsk.motor_points.v1, keyed by
viewer); "Emphasize motor points" = glowing magenta cores (depth-tested + see-through) and translucent
uncertainty spheres (radius = uncertainty_mm), muscles at 35 % opacity, hover tooltip (muscle, nerve, citation,
badge); text search over muscle/structure/nerve names or a click on a marker makes it the needle target. No
file / no points for the viewer -> "no motor-point data loaded"; nothing is invented. (4) Risk halos + safer
pathways (below). (5) Persistent disclaimer at the top of the panel.

**Risk classes** (table `RISK_TABLE` in the add-on, strict JSON between markers, parsed by the Python script so
both agree; first rule wins on the viewer category + optional Z-Anatomy vein flag + regex on "name id"):
artery (vessel default, incl. heart), vein (vt=v, vein/vena/_v_/jugular/azygos/portal/sinus/plexus, thoracic
duct), nerve (nerve system; cns spinal cord/cauda/roots/dura), pleura/lung/airway (lung/pleura/bronch/trachea in
viscera/organ), other organ (remaining viscera/organ and brain/eye), bone (not haloed; blocks a straight
path). Counts: vhm 33, vhf 31, zan_m 1325, zan_f 1300 risk structures. **Calibre**
(`risk_structures_q188.py`): shape-diameter function -- <=300 vertices per structure cast a ray along the inward
normal (outward side from the signed volume) to the opposite wall; radius = median/2, capped at half the smallest
bbox extent; fallback |2V/A| then bbox. Measurements only, no geometry, in the risk files (4 KB / 186 KB).

**Halo formula** (heuristic planning margin, exposed and editable in the panel):
`r = clamp( m_type * ( b0 * clamp((r_cal/3)^p, 0.5, 3) + k * L ), 2, 50 ) mm`, b0 = 4, p = 0.5, k = 0.035
(~ lateral miss of a 2 degree aiming error per mm of insertion), m: artery 1.0, pleura/lung 1.0, nerve 0.9,
organ 0.8, vein 0.6; L = current trajectory length, else the needle length. Halo = the structure's own viewing
mesh re-drawn inflated along its vertex normals by r (sign from the mesh's signed volume), translucent, colour by
class (artery red, vein blue, nerve yellow, pleura/lung cyan, other organ purple; legend in the panel), clipped by
the cut. Halo mode switches vessel/nerve/organ systems on and makes every other system 50-95 % transparent (slider).

**Safer pathways.** For the target: 720 Fibonacci-sphere directions; per direction the entry is the first skin
crossing (specimen viewers) or the outermost model surface (Z-Anatomy has no skin) within the needle length;
entries with body again within 30 mm outside the entry are "obstructed". Per path: clearance to every risk
structure from its surface vertices thinned to one per 2.5 mm voxel in a uniform point grid (8 mm cells, capsule
query), minus half the spacing; bone crossing by a triangle grid (10 mm cells, Amanatides-Woo). Colour: green =
outside every halo, amber = inside a halo but clear, red = touches (<= 0.75 mm) a risk structure / crosses bone /
obstructed. Cost = 0.004 L + sum w*exp(-margin/6) (+ penalties) ranks the best 3, drawn faintly; clicking an entry
dot, a faint line or "use" adopts it. The target's own structure is not scored. The region (surfaces, bone, risk
samples) is built once per target and reused. Timing (compute only, headless swiftshader box, real motor points): vhm 51-69 ms,
vhf 85-184 ms, zan_m 155-209 ms, zan_f 160-215 ms; largest = Z-Anatomy female sciatic target, 211,925 triangles,
14,202 risk samples from 105 structures: region 157 ms + 720 paths 58 ms.

**Stage / publish.** `python3 scripts/clinical/stage_clinical_files.py --all` (or a build dir) copies, next to
each page, `clinical_needle_tool.js` (<- clinical/needle_tool.js), `clinical_risk.json` (<-
clinical/data/risk_<viewer>.json) and `clinical_motor_points.json` (<- clinical/data/motor_points.json, skipped
and any stale copy removed if absent); `--remove` restores an anatomy-only build. Dirs: build/viewer_m_hr (vhm),
build/viewer_f_hr (vhf), build/viewer_zan_atlas (zan_m), build/viewer_zan_female (zan_f). Publish = add those
three files to the artifact `files` with the page and its geo .txt files. Specimen page HTML rebuilt with
build_viewer_html.py --external-bin (geometry files byte-identical, md5 checked). Z-Anatomy: verification builds
with the unchanged build command into build/viewer_zan_atlas_q188 and build/viewer_zan_female_q188 (`-o`, reports to
scratch; `--viewer zan_m|zan_f` when staging there). The main session does the final Z-Anatomy build into the real
dirs (it picks up the template hook). NOTE: two early Q188 runs of that build (16:2x-17:0x) wrote the real
build/viewer_zan_atlas, build/viewer_zan_female and data/derived/Q157_zan_atlas_report.json /
Q162_gap_closure_contralateral.json / Q168_zan_female_{build,report}.json with the then-current (Q186 WIP) script;
those dirs need the main session's final rebuild. `risk_structures_q188.py --viewer zan_m --source <page>` regenerates
a risk file from another build.

**Verification** (Chromium + swiftshader, scratchpad q188/): all four viewers 0 page errors with and without the
add-on files; modes a/b/c, motor points (Q187's real file: search -> target, hover tooltip, marker click; and the fixture), halos and safer pathways on a sciatic target and a forearm
motor point; phone width (390 px) usable. Tests: `tests/test_clinical_q188.py` (classification JS==Python,
halo formula properties, path colours, calibre of a known tube, staging, templates carry only a generic hook);
`tests/test_viewer_template.py` needle tests now check the add-on.

**Open issues.** Halo is a mesh inflation, so open tubes bulge at their ends and inverted/open meshes rely
on the signed-volume sign; Z-Anatomy has no skin or fat, so its entries/depths are on the outermost model surface
(real depth greater) and an entry beyond an air gap (e.g. between the thighs) is not detected; calibres come from
decimated viewing meshes (Z-Anatomy nerves are thin: radial nerve 0.3 mm radius); the halo formula and weights are
the owner-tunable heuristic, not validated; safer-path scoring ignores tissue planes and fascia; needs owner review
of the classification table (e.g. brain parts as "other organ").

(3) 429 trunk/shoulder structures: displacement from their own Z shape low-passed over their mesh (shear removed, position kept <= 15 mm; spinal-cord tracts excluded). (4) back/flank skin (front exactly v6): displacement smoothing, smooth radial offset onto her CT back outline (1.5 mm inside), moved outward over the refined muscles at the flank, seams re-welded. (5) 108 trunk structures clamped inside the FITTED skin envelope (nerve/vessel slivers), shape-guarded; then the existing clamp inside her skin. Badge on each moved card (fit_note).

Owner (translated): a CUT mode that places a plane + chooses a side and lifts the selected part away at that plane; then move up/down along the same plane; in ALL the models.
- **Audit (before).** Own template (`viewer/atlas_viewer.template.html`, three.js r128): Q188 Cut button + `#cut-panel` (sagittal/axial/coronal/facing me, one slider, flip side); `material.clippingPlanes` on every anatomy mesh (`renderer.localClippingEnabled`), picking filtered by `cutWorld.distanceToPoint`; no plane drawing, no mm readout, no step/key/wheel, no place-on-model, panel `absolute right:12px;top:48px` 236 px wide (not phone-aware, covered by the phone sheets). Z template (`viewer/zan_atlas.template.html`, raw WebGL): buried in the left rail ("Cut plane" section: axis buttons, `cut on`, `flip side`, `depth` 0-100 %), per-fragment `discard` in the screen shader AND the ID-pick shader plus AABB culling (`passClip`), no on-screen plane, no top-bar button; the rail is a phone bottom sheet. Neither had a cap, either exposed `cut()/setCut()` to the add-on (kept half `n.p + c >= 0`), halos clipped, trajectory not.
- **Built: one shared controller** `viewer/cut_mode/{cut_mode.js,.css,.html}` (`NMSKCutMode(E)`), inlined verbatim between `CUT-MODE <kind> begin/end` markers in both templates by `scripts/sync_cut_mode_q197.py` (a test fails if a template drifts). State = plane `{x: n0.x = a}` + removed side `rs`; presets (sagittal/axial/coronal = atlas axes through the model centre or the last placed point; facing me = camera direction when pressed, through the screen centre); **Place on model** (arm, then click/tap: plane through the hit point, current orientation); side = two buttons ("remove right/left", "upper/lower", "front/back", "far/near") + flip side; defaults unchanged (+axis side removed; facing me removes the near side); **move along the normal**: slider (mm readout, range = the model's extent along n0), -10/-1/+1/+10 buttons, ArrowUp/Right +1, ArrowDown/Left -1, Shift = x10, PageUp/PageDown +-10, wheel over the slider; reset cut, exit cut, collapse. The plane is drawn as an SVG overlay over the canvas (translucent rectangle sized to the model, near-plane clipped, arrow + "removed" toward the removed side, ring at the placed point) -- identical code in both engines. Phone: panel docks at the bottom (38-40 px targets, collapsible), steps aside while an own-viewer sheet / Z layers sheet is open, moves to the top while the add-on's needle panel is open (`:has`); desktop Z: moves left of the needle panel. Nothing is stored (localStorage not used: the default must stay the old default).
- **Engines.** Own: `apply()` sets `cutLocal/cutWorld` + `clippingPlanes` on all meshes AND the two anchor markers; `pickHit` ignores the removed half (hit point -> root-local mm = the placed point). Z: `clip.P=(n_r,w)`, same shader discard (screen + ID pass); NEW depth pass (`dprog`, gl_FragCoord.z packed RGBA, highp check, same clip/box tests) read back at the click and unprojected along the camera ray = hit point (fallback without highp: the picked structure's centre nearest to the ray). Add-on hook unchanged: `cut()` kept half, `setCut({normal,point})` -> a facing plane through `point`, `three.clippingPlanes()`, `ctx.clip`. **Needle decision:** halos are clipped (they follow the anatomy), the needle trajectory/entry/target items stay UNclipped so the path remains visible through the cut (documented in both templates and docs/VIEWER_README.md). Skin is a normal layer and is clipped; there are no decals. **No cap** (cross-section fill) -- the cut shows the open double-sided surfaces; a stencil cap was judged not robust for these non-watertight meshes.
- **Regeneration without recomputing geometry (data identical).** Own male/female: `scripts/build_viewer_html.py --bundle build/viewer_*_hr_q193 --external-bin` (new `--template` arg) re-folds the existing `bundle.json`/`bundle.b64`: proven first by rendering with the OLD template (git HEAD) -> html and all geo files byte-identical to the built q193 pages (female incl. the "(VH female)" title sed). Z: new `scripts/zanatomy/rebuild_html_from_built.py` lifts the three data literals (`__ANATOMY_BIN__`, `__ANATOMY_BIN_FILES__`, `__ANATOMY_MANIFEST__`) out of the built page as raw text, copies the geo files byte-identical, picks the wording block from `manifest.variant` using the builder's own tables (vhf = female fitted, vhm = Z male fitted, native_female = base female, none = Z male) and fills the new template; `--old-template` re-render of all four built Z pages with the HEAD template was byte-identical, and the new page's literals are compared to the old page's before it reports success. Driver `scripts/rebuild_pages_q197.sh` (one page at a time, ~6 s total). Outputs: `build/q197/viewer_m_hr`, `viewer_f_hr`, `viewer_zan_atlas`, `viewer_base_female`, `viewer_zan_male_fitted`, `viewer_zan_female` (same file names as the source dirs; clinical_* files NOT copied -- stage them with `scripts/clinical/stage_clinical_files.py --viewer vhm|vhf|zan_m|zan_f` as before; existing build/viewer_* untouched).
- **Verification.** `scripts/zanatomy/q197_cutcheck.py ROOT PAGE own|zan PREFIX THREE_JS` (headless Chromium swiftshader, desktop 1400x900 + phone 390x844 touch): cut on, place on model (overlay ring lands within 1 px of the click -> the plane passes through the clicked point, also proves the Z depth unprojection), side buttons/flip, steps, keys, wheel, slider, presets, selection with the cut on, x-ray + source facet with the cut on, add-on `cut()/setCut()` contract and (staged copy) the needle panel's "Cut through target", reset, exit. Screenshots + JSON in the session scratchpad (`r/`). Tests: `tests/test_cut_mode_q197.py` (18: markers identical, controls/handlers in both templates, controller logic under node, hook contract, re-inject data blocks/wording for all four variants, template-only path).
- Known limits: no cap; plane visual has no depth test (drawn over the model); the cut is one plane (no second plane / slab); on the phone, tapping a structure with the cut on opens the own-viewer sheet which hides the cut panel until the sheet is closed; `:has()`-based placement next to the needle panel needs a current browser (older ones overlap, still usable); "right/left" words follow the viewers' own axis labels (+X right).
- Main session (2026-10-07 ~09:00): Q197 Cut mode PUBLISHED on all six pages (own male v84, own female v67, Z male base v11, Z female fitted v12, Z male fitted v2, female base v2); geometry unchanged (re-injected data, verified byte-identical). Shared controller viewer/cut_mode/*, synced into both templates (scripts/sync_cut_mode_q197.py). Needle trajectory stays unclipped by design; no cap on the cut (meshes not watertight). Hub test updated to the 3-row wording. Owner (translated): "First of all the anatomy must be correct. Check in ALL of them whether it really holds: everything continuous and in place. What I saw was around the ELBOW."

Z male base / generic: elbow OK both sides; remaining issues are all source (nerve/vessel branch meshes in separate pieces, multi-piece muscles such as longus colli, trapezius piece 31 % at 18 mm); female variants additionally have a skin hole at the perineum (2 urogenital patches deleted, Q196).
- **Fix approaches:** ct_block_seam / bone_block_truncation (own) -> re-segment across the seam from the cryosection photographs, or complete the truncated bones/muscles with Z parts snapped to the surviving bones (own female first: absent left forearm/hand, right ulna); registration_mismatch (transferred forearm muscles, Z-fit vessels/nerves) -> bone-driven non-rigid re-registration + snap origins/insertions to bone footprints (Q194 method, extend to vessels/nerves/skin); held_unrefined (his forearm/hand/wrist) -> Q195 hand/forearm queue, fit the humerus roll with the ulna as reference; blend_zone (her left arm) -> refit in one frame instead of a 100 mm blend; skin_envelope -> weld shared patch vertices after fitting, re-add the female urogenital surface; source_defect -> not fixable by fitting (local repair or accept).
- **Recommended order:** 1 own female elbows/left forearm (largest, no joint at all) ; 2 Z fitted female left arm (owner's sighting) then her right; 3 own male elbows (cut planes + overlapping Z forearm); 4 Z fitted male forearm/hand/wrist (right wrist 28 mm) and the humerus roll; 5 skin patch welds on both Z-fitted pages + female urogenital surface; 6 Z base source quirks (document only).
- **Caveats / limits:** thresholds are mine (listed in the JSON); carrying/twist angles are not reliable on own models whose humerus is cut at the elbow (skipped there); the frame-offset and adjacency-tear numbers are relative to the Z base and ignore bone-bone/skin pairs; elbow fill profile (`elbow_fill_profiles.png`) does not discriminate (all models 0.2-0.5) and is not used; vessels/nerves in Z are partly multi-piece by design so nerve gaps are capped at moderate; two audit jobs never ran together (peak ~2.5 GB each, no OOM).

- **Method (scripts/transfer/q200_*.py; one driver `q200_elbow_repair.py --body vhm|vhf`, whole pipeline `q200_all.sh`)**: Z full-res meshes (`collect_zan`) carried by the existing Q168/Q195 per-bone transforms (his: Q195_zan_to_vhm.json, hers: Q168_zan_to_vhf.json). (1) BONES: radius/ulna get a bounded joint correction (`q200_chain.py`: scale 0.92-1.15, rot <= 10 deg, shift <= 20 mm about the articular end, keeps the one-sided chamfer to the measured piece, closes the joint to a 1.8 mm contact patch with the measured humerus + its Z completion); her right ulna 9.4 -> 0.4 mm gap (chamfer 1.4 -> 1.3 mm), then every flat cap of humerus/radius/ulna in the elbow zone is continued. (2) CONTINUATION of a structure cut flat at a data-block seam (`q200_continue.py`): caps = axis-aligned planar faces at a structure extreme; a seam = plane shared by >= 3 structures (or a lone cap >= 60 mm2 whose end is > 8 mm from its bone); the fitted Z counterpart is aligned to the measured part in a 45 mm window (in-plane translation / small rigid, never along the limb), clipped at the plane, and joined: LOFT from the measured cap outline to the Z section (cap closes the muscle across its length) or LOCAL (cap is a face along the muscle / Z section much smaller: the Z piece is closed by a planar face on the cap and the uncovered cap stays flat and is reported); far end carried onto its bone (<= 35 mm, smooth ramp), kept inside the skin (nearest-surface inset) and out of the bones. Gates: Z fit vs the measured part within 30 mm of the seam <= 25 mm median, Z beyond the plane >= 10 mm, else HELD with the number. The measured entry is NEVER edited; the continuation is a new entry `<id>_zfill` (subject xfer_zan2vh?_elbow_q200 = class 'Filled from Z-Anatomy'; badge states fit error, seam plane, attachment). (3) HER LEFT forearm (absent): Z radius/ulna/carpals/metacarpals/phalanges on the Q192 per-bone similarities (placed on her left-hand/forearm cryosection photographs, evidence fit 0.5-1.1 mm), radius/ulna joint-corrected against her own humerus_l (gap 4.3/8.1 -> 0.3/0.4 mm, shift <= 8 mm, scale 1.02); 16 left forearm muscles absent from her model taken from the Q194 build (placed on her photographed muscle compartment) carried with the same correction, inside her skin / out of bones, ends carried onto their bones (5-13 mm); her 5 measured left extensors continued/attached where the Q194 Z agrees. (4) VESSELS/NERVES (none existed): 19 Z arm vessels/nerves per arm (brachial a./vv., median, ulnar, radial, musculocutaneous, PIN/AIN, ulnar/radial vv., basilic/cephalic/median cubital vv., collateral aa.) by the same transform (her left: Q194), nearest-surface skin inset, bone push (held if > 5 % stays inside a bone: male 6, female 2), subjects `xfer_zan2vh?_armvessels_q200`; position estimates (badge says so). - **Root cause (measured, confirmed)**: two frames inside ONE arm. Her skin mesh, her left forearm / hand bones (Q192) and the Q194 forearm soft tissue are in the CRYOSECTION-PHOTOGRAPH frame; the Z humerus was fitted to her CT humerus label (CT frame). Her skin silhouette matches the photographs (IoU 0.77-0.94 at y 260-460, shifts 0-6 mm), so the CT-frame humerus sat 17-30 mm behind where the photographs put it, inside the posterior muscle mass. Together with the Q192 forearm bones this left the elbow joint OPEN: nearest-surface gap at the Z-source humerus-radius/ulna contact patch (161 / 159 samples touching within 8 mm in the Z source) median 27.4 mm LEFT (Z source 5.4 mm), 9.8 mm RIGHT (the Z humerus_r / ulna_r were fitted as FOV-cut parts: ulna top 2 mm above the humerus bottom, the Z source has 24). RIGHT: her CT labels carry the whole chain, the humerus stays, the forearm bones swing (bounded) until the Z-source joint closes while the label coverage stays. (2) FIELD: D(x) = sum_b w_b(x) D_b(x) over the moving bones and the fixed bones (shoulder girdle, ribs, carpals, hand: D = 0) + a null anchor 90 mm out, w_b = 1/(d_b + 6 mm)^2 (no axial blend length: the transition is where the nearest bone changes); |D| < 0.8 mm gated to exactly 0 (tissue away from the arm stays bit-identical). Skin patches do not move with it. (3) PER STRUCTURE: candidates (field, field low-passed 10 / 25 mm, mean translation) pushed out of the displayed bones, inside her skin, volume 0.65-1.5x (non-muscle closed meshes +-10 %), cost = skin + bone + stretch + 6 x folds + attachment excess, the field is kept unless a candidate is better by > 2; origin / insertion footprints (Z-source vertices < 8 mm from humerus / radius / ulna / scapula / clavicle) that sit > 3 mm further from their bone than in the Z source are brought back by a smooth end translation (<= 10 mm); pairs that touch in the Z source (< 3 mm) within 100 mm of the elbow joint and are > 5 mm apart (vessel / nerve pairs > 3 mm) close up (Gaussian end translation, <= 10 mm from the field result); neighbour-muscle overlap separated on the SHIPPED meshes (Q194 separation, <= 5 mm, fold tolerance 1 %). Source classes: **rule_based** (documented rule on the person's own mesh), **z_fill** (a dedicated Z-Anatomy part mesh as fitted; error = the structure's own fit-badge figure, Q168 / Q195), **never 'measured'**. Rules: `z_part_mesh`, `end_snap_bone` (muscle-mesh end touches the bone within a tolerance; nearest bone-surface point to the contact patch; error = patch radius), `cc_ligament_ratio` (conoid 0.24 / trapezoid 0.17 of clavicle length, Rios 2007; error sqrt(SD^2 + 3^2) ~ 5 mm), `mtj_by_distance_from_origin` (ST / BF long head MTJ 99 +/- 15 mm from the ischial tuberosity, Miller 2007), `mtj_interface` (muscle meets tendon mesh), `passage_contact` (nerve mesh within 3 mm of fascia / muscle mesh). Result: own male 28 placements on 15 parts, own female 29 / 15, Z male 121 / 62 (71 Z part meshes + 50 rule), Z female 123 / 63; the other ~285-330 parts per body are text-only. Reasons recorded, e.g. muscle meshes end 20-95 mm short of bone (tendon not modelled: tibialis posterior, semimembranosus origin / insertion, pectoralis major on the own bodies), retinacula / nerves absent in the own bundles.
- **Deltoid sectors NOT derived on the two own bodies (single mesh)**: the azimuth sector rule about the humeral head, leave-one-body-out against the Z deltoid part meshes, gives vertex accuracy 67-75 % and centroid errors 6-40 mm (max 40) -> rejected; a label transfer from the fitted Z deltoid was not used either (own-vs-Z deltoid surface mismatch mean 6-9 mm, p90 12-21 mm). Deltoid heads are placed only on the Z bodies (their own three part meshes, error 10.3 mm male / 19.8 mm female from the badges). The cc ratio rule vs the Z conoid / trapezoid meshes: median 15.8 mm apart (Z attaches at ~0.30-0.34 / 0.21 of clavicle length, Rios 0.24 / 0.17) - recorded as a consistency check, Z is not truth.
- [x] **Tests** `tests/test_q219.py` (22 pass, ~30-65 s): schema, every row has a citation + resolvable refs (verified rows need a journal ref, unverified rows a textbook / owner ref), no unused refs, structure ids resolve to a `data/` record or a body structure, `maps_to` ids exist in the 4 bodies (snapshot `data/derived/Q219_structure_ids.json`), owner examples present (deltoid >= 3 heads, SM >= 5 insertion rows, TP >= 8, all six part types), count disagreement recorded, coverage file consistent; geometry: every part placed or text-only, class never 'measured', error bound on every placement, own-body points inside the skin shell (or within 2 mm), end-snap points exactly on the bone surface (<= 0.2 mm), Z points inside their bbox / hull, MTJ points inside the muscle. Needs `build/` for the mesh checks (skips if absent).
- **OPEN DESIGN QUESTION FOR THE OWNER (phase 2, wire after Q218 lands; no template touched in phase 1)**: how should the viewers show parts? (a) **selectable sub-structures**: each placed part becomes a pickable sub-mesh / region of its structure (needs per-part meshes or vertex sets; only the Z bodies have them for ~35 parts, own bodies would get sectors only where a validated rule exists - currently none for the deltoid); (b) a **Parts list on each structure card** (text, counts and prevalences, citation + 'unverified' flag, set disagreements shown as 'reported 3 / 5 / 6'; works for all 347 rows on all 4 viewers, no geometry needed) - my recommendation as the default; (c) **markers** at the 28-123 placed positions per body (attachment points on bone, MTJ, passage points) with the error radius drawn as a ghost sphere, toggled per part type. A hybrid (b) everywhere + (c) for the placed ones is cheap. Also decide: show 'unverified' rows (32) or hide them by default; show disputed counts as a range; whether Z-fill positions may appear on the own-body viewers (they cannot today: own bodies have no Z part meshes).
- Open / next: more verified rows for head-neck, foot intrinsics, hand intrinsics (lumbricals, thenar), deep back, fascia compartments, bursae; finger MCP collateral rows are unverified (no PubMed anatomy abstract for the long-finger MCP in this pass); a validated deltoid / triceps / gastrocnemius sector rule (needs per-fibre evidence, e.g. the cryosection photographs); tendon meshes would turn many text-only insertions into placements (the own bundles carry only adductor magnus, iliopsoas and quadriceps tendons).

## Q218 (2026-10-11) -- Cut mode SLICE THICKNESS: review of the main session's design, functional check, six pages regenerated without recomputing geometry (NOT published; build/q218/<page>/)
Owner (translated): "With cut, need an option to decide how many layers will be left, i.e. the width of the slice: from the full rest of the body up to a few millimetres." Design (main session, kept as is): kept slab `0 <= kn.p + c <= th` behind the plane (th = 0 = no far plane = the old behaviour and the default), `#cut-thsl` 1..100 mm with the far end = "whole rest of body", buttons 2/5/10/25/all (`data-th`), readout `#cut-th`, `S.th` / `setThickness()` / `apply(kn,c,on,th)`, dashed far-face outline in the overlay; own engine = 2nd three.js clipping plane `cutWorld2` (+ the picking filter), Z engine = `uClip2` in the screen / ID / depth shaders + `clip.P2` + AABB cull in `passClip`.
- **Review: defects found and fixed (surgical).** (1) Z add-on halos: `ctx.clip` carried only the first plane and the add-on's own GL program (`clinical/needle_tool.js`, GLOverlay) discards by one plane, so halos of structures beyond the slab were still drawn -> `ctx.clip2` (additive; `[0,0,0,-1]` = none) + `uClip2` in the add-on shader (own pages are already right: `api.three.clippingPlanes()` returns both planes). (2) Add-on `pickPoint` -> `rayNearest(i, o, d, cut)` accepted the nearest surface in the kept HALF, i.e. possibly an invisible point beyond the slab (ray entering through the far face) -> optional `api.cutSlab()` (mm, 0 = all; both engines) and `rayNearest` skips hits beyond it. (3) The add-on's `setCut()` ("Cut through target", meant to expose deep tissue) kept a leftover thin slab -> `setFromSpec` now sets th = 0 (`reset cut` already did). (4) `__viewerState().clip.th` added (Z). (5) The Q197 node harness of the controller failed after the controller edit (mock lacked `cut-th`/`cut-thsl`): mock + tests updated. **Contract intact:** `api.cut()` is still the kept half `[n, c]`, `three.clippingPlanes()`, `ctx.clip`, `setCut({normal, point})` unchanged; `cutSlab()` and `ctx.clip2` are optional extras, an add-on that ignores them behaves as before (old `clinical_needle_tool.js` + new page works, only slab-blind halos). Checked and fine: own `cutWorld2.constant = th - c - n2.rootPos` (root is translation-only), `1e7` far plane when th = 0, markers + halos use the same 2-plane array, Z ID/depth passes set both uniforms and the pick cache follows `drawCount` (every apply sets `need`), the key handler leaves the thickness slider its native arrows, exit keeps the value (re-enter restores it), flip keeps it.
- **Tests** `tests/test_cut_mode_q197.py` (22, was 18 + failing): ids `cut-th/cut-thsl/cut-thick`, `data-th` 2/5/10/25/0, slider 1..100, engine strings of both engines (2-plane array, picking filter, constant formula, 3 shader declarations / discards / uniform tables, AABB m2, `cutSlab`, `ctx.clip2`, add-on `uClip2`), node controller thickness test (default 0, presets, slider far end = all, clamps 0.5..100, flip/move keep it, exit/re-enter, setFromSpec and reset drop it), own-page re-injection + platform skeleton unwrap + regen script. `tests/test_clinical_q188.py` 12 pass.
- **Functional check** `scripts/zanatomy/q218_slicecheck.py ROOT PAGE own|zan PREFIX THREE_JS` (headless Chromium swiftshader, desktop 1400x900 + phone 390x844 touch; env `Q218_VIEWPORTS=phone|desktop`): axial plane through the centre, camera level with it (front view, zoomed on the torso) so the slab is a horizontal band on screen. Rendered canvas vs an empty-scene reference: with 5 mm / 25 mm / 10 mm (plane moved 40 mm) / flipped side, ALL changed pixels lie inside the projected band (+-4 px), none outside, and something is inside; picture with "all" == the picture before any slab (0.0 % changed); engine evidence: own = every mesh carries `[cutWorld, cutWorld2]` and a vertex test with the engine's own planes keeps exactly the slab (493 of 177 962 sampled vertices, 0 mismatches), Z = the AABB cull passes exactly the 341 of 2 966 objects whose box meets the slab (0 mismatches). Picking: `api.pick` over a grid outside the band: 0 hits with the slab (420 own / 91 Z points; 196 / 30 hits with "all"), a real click / tap on the body beyond the slab selects nothing (control: the same click with "all" selects), looking straight down at the 5 mm plane every picked structure's box meets the slab, "Place on model" works with a slab. UI: preset/slider/readout/aria-pressed/dashed far face, reset, exit, re-enter, needle "Cut through target" drops the slab, `cutSlab()`, panel inside the viewport, 0 page errors, no horizontal scroll. Pages checked: own male (build/q218/viewer_m_hr, with the needle tool staged), Z base male (build/q218/viewer_zan_atlas, needle tool staged) and own female; both viewports; result lines and screenshots in the session scratchpad `r218/` (desktop/phone x 8 steps per page). Phone: the panel is now ~411 px of 844 (was one row group less); it docks at the bottom and collapses (arrow), the scene sits above it.
- **Regeneration, no geometry recomputed** `scripts/regen_cut_q218.sh [own_m own_f zan_m zan_f base_f base_m]` (default all six; `SRC_<page>=dir` overrides a source, `Q218_OUT` the output root, `NEEDLE_REFRESH=0` copies the needle tool verbatim): per page the data literals + geo files are lifted out of the latest built page as raw text and re-injected into the current template (own: new `scripts/rebuild_own_html_from_built.py`, no bundle needed; Z: `scripts/zanatomy/rebuild_html_from_built.py`, both use `scripts/platform_wrap.py`), every other sibling file (clinical_*) is copied, `clinical_needle_tool.js` is refreshed from `clinical/needle_tool.js` (the halo/pick fix), `index.html` = the page, then `scripts/verify_regen_q218.py` (JSON per page in `build/q218/_verify/`) checks: geo files sha256-identical, literals identical, other siblings identical, and that the SOURCE page equals the template of a past git revision + the data (found automatically) while the NEW page equals the current template + the same data. For the pending Q217 pages: `SRC_own_m=build/q217/viewer_m_hr SRC_zan_m=build/q217/viewer_zan_vhm scripts/regen_cut_q218.sh own_m zan_m` (output dirs keep the source dir names, i.e. they replace build/q218/viewer_m_hr and viewer_zan_vhm).

## Q220 (2026-10-12) -- PARTS in the viewers (Q219 phase 2): a Parts list in every structure card + point markers on the model; six pages regenerated without recomputing geometry (NOT published; build/q220/<page>/)
Design = the one recommended to the owner (no objection received): (b) a **Parts list** in each structure card + (c) **point markers** for the parts that have a position on THAT body; Z-fill positions only on Z pages (the own bodies get rule-based ones only); unverified rows are shown, flagged; disputed counts are shown as the sources' numbers (not one hard-coded count).
- **Card (all six pages; own = details sheet, Z = info panel).** For a selected structure whose `structure_id` has rows in `data/anatomy/structure_parts.json`: section *Parts (N)* with, per row, a type badge (head / origin / insertion / ligament component / MTJ / fascial passage), the name, an *unverified* badge (textbook / owner rows; their note says so), a one-line description, anchor / reported-in / evidence / passage text where the row has it, the citation as link text (journal, year, volume + `PMID n` -> pubmed, `DOI` -> doi.org; textbook rows say "page not verified"), a *marker* tag when the part has a placed marker on this body, and, above the list, the **disputed-count note** where the part set is disputed (semimembranosus: `3 (Benninger, Olewnik) / 5 (Beltran) / 6 (De Maeseneer)`, deltoid 3 / 7 / 19, tibialis posterior 1 / 2 / 3 / 4, ... plus the set's note under "about this count"). Click (tap / Enter) a row: placed -> the camera focuses its marker and its card opens; not placed -> "text only (no placement)" + the reason from the Q219 geometry file; placed but cut away / hidden -> says so. Z part meshes (zan_clavicular_part_of_deltoid_muscle_r ...) show their structure's rows too.
- **Markers.** Shown for the selected structure (its side), or for ALL placed parts with the toolbar toggle **Parts markers** (`#t-parts`, own `#tools`, Z `#topright`; absent when the page has no placement). A marker = hollow ring + label (DOM, shared code; ring 22 px selected / 16 px otherwise, 28 px on touch) + a **solid dot drawn by the engine with the depth test** (own: `THREE.Points` under `root`, transparent + last so the translucent muscles do not tint it; Z: GL points after the anatomy, depthMask off) nudged 3 mm toward the camera: hidden behind opaque tissue, visible with X-ray (verified by pixel colour on all 12 page x viewport runs: with nothing selected and all markers on, probed dots are invisible behind opaque tissue and visible with X-ray -- 5 of 8 on the own male, 4 on the own female, >= 1 on each Z page -- and X-ray never hides one). Colour = source class: amber = **rule-based**, blue = **Z-Anatomy fill**; never drawn as measured. Hover (desktop) / tap or click (pinned; Esc or x closes) opens the **marker card**: part name, type, class, side, **error bound** (+ its basis; for a Z part mesh in the unfitted reference body "not stated" + the extent of the mesh it stands for), method, atlas-mm position, "a model position ..., not a measurement", citation links; the focused / hovered marker also gets a dashed circle of its error radius. **Respects Cut mode:** a marker is hidden when its position is not in the kept part `0 <= kn.p + c <= th` (the plane + the Q218 slice thickness: `api.cut()` / `api.cutSlab()` = `cutCtl.state().th`), also its DOM ring / label / dot; and it follows its structure's state (layer off, hide, isolate, source facet, Z solo / side filter / fade-hide). The "Place on model" armed click is not intercepted (rings have `pointer-events:none` while `body.cut-armed`).
- **Data delivery.** `parts_data.json` beside each page (public anatomy layer, CC BY-SA compatible; NOT a `clinical_*` file; a test greps it for motor-point / needle / risk words), fetched at load; absent / HTTP error / not a `nmsk.parts_sidecar` file = no Parts section, no toggle, the page behaves exactly as before (checked with a 404: 0 page errors). Built by `python3 scripts/anatomy/q220/build_parts_sidecar.py --html PAGE.html --body vhm|vhf|zan_m|zan_f|zbase_m|zbase_f -o parts_data.json` from the table + the page's own mesh ids (own: bundle-json, Z: manifest) + the placement file of that body. Mesh -> structure: the Q219 `maps_to` snapshot, plus `_zfill` pieces, plus **name matching for ids the snapshot missed** (the Z names `zan_tibialis_posterior_muscle_l` etc. were not in the snapshot: Z pages went from 228 to 287 reachable parts), plus the meshes a placement was derived from (so nerve passages show on the nerve and the muscle). **Every placement is checked against the page's own geometry** (point on / within its error bound of the meshes it was derived from, or inside the part mesh's box); a placement that no longer fits is dropped to text-only with the reason (`geometry.dropped`), so a re-built page cannot show a stale marker. 143-148 KB (own), 224-226 KB (Z) per page.
- **Per page** (parts reachable / structures / meshes with parts / placements on how many parts; all 0 dropped): own male 204 / 54 / 127 / 28 on 15; own female 210 / 56 / 131 / 29 on 15; Z male fitted 287 / 77 / 211 / 121 on 62; Z female fitted 287 / 77 / 211 / 123 on 63; base male 287 / 77 / 210 / 125 on 63; base female 287 / 77 / 210 / 125 on 63. 62 of the 347 parts have no mesh of the structure on any page (first carpometacarpal, rectum, elbow collateral complexes, pes anserinus, Achilles, rectus sheath, MPFL, lumbricals, iliopsoas tendon ... : the viewers carry no mesh under that id): not shown (phase 1b: alias table or the structure's surrogate meshes).
- **BASE PAGES -- frame check (stated as asked).** Z male fitted (`zan_m`) is NOT in the frame of the base male page: the fit moves structures (tibialis posterior centroid 89 mm apart on the male pair, 56 mm on the female pair), and 64 of the 117 `zan_m` placements (66 of 119 `zan_f` on the base female page) lie 14-211 mm from the meshes they were derived from on the base page (the other 53 are bones / structures the fit barely moves) -> **the fitted placements are NOT used on the base pages.** The base female (Z generic body, female variant) IS in the base male frame (2 914 of the 2 939 shared meshes are vertex-identical; the 25 that differ are female-variant edits of the groin / pelvic-floor / lower abdominal-wall muscles: adductors, gracilis, pectineus, oblique / transversus / pyramidalis, levator ani, pubococcygeus ...). ## Q226 (2026-10-12) -- IMAGING mode, phase 1: simulated CT + MRI of the cut plane (PRIVATE clinical add-on; NOT published; pages build/q226/<dir>)
Owner (translated): "In each of the models add an IMAGING mode: define a CUT, the thickness of the observed SLICE, then open a SPLIT screen that simulates CT, and MRI according to the various SEQUENCES, as is customary [MPR, MIP, etc.]. Also an ULTRASOUND mode (next task, not now)." This is phase 1 (CT + MRI); ultrasound is the next task.
- **What it is, and is not.** A SIMULATION computed from the segmented anatomical MESHES of the viewer, badged on screen ("Simulated from meshes -- not a scan", also burned into every image and the PNG export) with an Info panel (assumptions, every tissue class with its source and verification status, equations, mapping report of the page). No patient data, no acquisition / reconstruction physics.
- **Licensing layout (like the needle tool, Q188).** Everything is the owner's PRIVATE clinical layer (`clinical/LICENSE_PRIVATE.md`): `clinical/imaging_tool.js` (engine + UI, ~1300 lines), `clinical/data/imaging_tissues.json` (tissue table with citations, structure -> class mapping rules, bone model, CT windows, MR sequence presets). Staged BESIDE the page by `scripts/clinical/stage_clinical_files.py` as `clinical_imaging_tool.js` + `clinical_imaging_tissues.json`; never inlined in a public template. The public templates carry ONE generic line `<script src="clinical_imaging_tool.js">` after the needle line (the needle hook `window.NMSKClinical.attach(api)` is single-add-on, so the imaging file CHAINS: it saves the existing `NMSKClinical`, installs its own `attach` that first calls the needle add-on's `attach` (return value unchanged) and then starts imaging; with no needle file it simply defines `NMSKClinical`). Without the staged files the pages are exactly the atlases of before (404 for the optional script, as for the needle file; 0 page errors). The Z pages keep their quantised geometry in memory only when `NMSKClinical` exists (so Z pages WITHOUT needle files also work: Z male fitted, base female). No other template change. NOTE: the template line was swept into the shared commit 3c1b488 ("WIP: Q225/Q226/Q227 agents in progress") by a blanket `git add` of another agent, i.e. not the one small atomic commit asked for; the diff of that commit for the two templates is my line + the Q227 cut-face hunks of the other agent.
- **Stage / regen commands (all six pages).** `scripts/regen_imaging_q226.sh [own_m own_f zan_m zan_f zan_vhm base_f]` (default all six; ~1 min; sources only read): per page re-injects the published page's data literals into the CURRENT template (geo files byte-identical, verified; the html differs from the published page by exactly the one hook line), copies every other sibling (clinical_*, parts_data.json), stages the two imaging files; output `build/q226/<source dir name>/`. Sources: own male `build/q224/viewer_m_hr`, own female `build/q224/viewer_f_hr`, Z male base `build/q222/viewer_zan_atlas`, Z female fitted `build/q222/viewer_zan_female`, Z male fitted `build/q222/viewer_zan_vhm`, female base `build/q222/viewer_base_female` (override `SRC_<page>=dir`; `Q226_OUT`, `TEMPLATE_OWN`, `TEMPLATE_ZAN` env). The script refuses sources under `*q225*` (Z-fit still being built elsewhere) unless `Q226_ALLOW_Q225=1`: when Q225 lands, `Q226_ALLOW_Q225=1 SRC_zan_f=build/q225/<dir> SRC_zan_vhm=build/q225/<dir> scripts/regen_imaging_q226.sh zan_f zan_vhm`, or, if the Q225 pages are already built from a template with the hook, just `python3 scripts/clinical/stage_clinical_files.py --imaging-only build/q225/<dir>` (any dir name; `--imaging` adds the imaging files to the normal needle staging; `--remove` takes all five clinical names away). Publish = add `clinical_imaging_tool.js` + `clinical_imaging_tissues.json` to the artifact `files` of the pages the owner chooses (nothing published here; the owner decides which pages).
- **Geometry method (kernel in a Web Worker; falls back to the main thread).** All structures of the page (`api.list()` / `api.geometry(i)`) are packed once into one position / index buffer (60-70 MB cloned to the worker, 0.3-0.8 s pack, own male 593 structures / 2.56 M triangles, own female 630, Z pages ~2 950 / 3.1 M). Per request: vertex signed distance + in-plane pixel coordinates for the structures whose bbox meets the plane / FOV (once per plane, reused by all sub-slices); per sub-slice the triangle-plane segments (two edge crossings per triangle, half-open sign rule so shared vertices count once); even-odd scan-line fill per structure into a mask; painter order by tissue-class priority (fat < skin < fibrous < muscle < organs < cartilage < bone < blood < air); pixels carry a tissue CLASS id (uint8) plus, for the middle sub-slice, the owning structure id. Skin = union of all skin structures' segments (Z skin is 250 patches): even-odd fill of the union + 8-connected outline, then the body = skin fill + outline + everything painted, closed by a 4-connected flood fill of the exterior from the image border (robust to small skin gaps); inside the body and not covered by any structure = FAT baseline (documented assumption), outside = AIR; a thin skin rim (1.8 mm) is drawn at the body boundary. **Open meshes:** a scan line with an odd number of crossings (hole in the surface) repeats the previous row's spans and is counted ("n open-mesh rows repaired" in the status line). **Sheets:** structures that are surfaces, not volumes (fascia, septa, joint capsules / membranes / retinacula, dura; rule `render: sheet`, 121 on each Z page, 5-7 on the own pages) are drawn as one-pixel lines after the solids -- filling the 'investing abdominal fascia' shells wiped out the abdomen and gave 527 bad rows per slice; with sheets 60 remain (open stomach / duodenum). **Bone model** (the meshes are outer surfaces only): per bone kind (long / short tubular / flat-irregular / skull / tooth) pixels within a cortical thickness of the mesh edge (exact Euclidean distance transform) = cortical bone; inside, the central part (20-80 %) of a long bone's PCA axis = medullary canal (yellow marrow), everywhere else cancellous bone with a thin cortex that thickens smoothly towards the shaft; thickness = min(8 mm, 0.42 x local radius) (anchor: femoral mid-shaft ~ 6 mm of a ~ 28 mm bone) -- ASSUMPTIONS, not measured on these bodies.
- **Slab (thickness).** The imaging panel has its own thickness (0 = single slice, 1-100 mm; presets 0 1 3 5 10 25 50) combined from sub-slices as AVERAGE (thick MPR), MIP or MinIP, for CT and for every MR sequence. Sub-slices at <= 1 mm (adaptive: 5 sub-slices in the quick pass while dragging, up to 25 in MPR / 49 in single view at rest). The cut-plane view uses exactly the kept slab of the existing Cut mode (`0 <= kn.p + c <= th` behind the plane); axial / coronal / sagittal use a slab of the same thickness centred on the crosshair. A thickness set in the Cut panel (th > 0) is adopted by the imaging panel; the button "3D slab" pushes the imaging thickness into the Cut panel's slider (default off, so the 3D side keeps showing the whole rest of the body). No template API was added: the add-on drives the page's own Cut controls through their DOM ids (`#t-cut`, `#cut-axis`, `#cut-pos`, `#cut-thsl`) and `api.cut()` / `api.cutSlab()` / `api.setCut()`.
- **CT.** HU per tissue class from the table (window presets soft W400/L40, bone W1800/L400, lung W1500/L-600, brain W80/L40, MSK W1000/L250 = owner convention without a citation; custom W/L). **MRI (1.5 T).** Pools of (fraction, PD, T1, T2, T2*, fat flag) per class; standard equations: spin echo `PD (1 - e^(-TR/T1)) e^(-TE/T2)`; inversion recovery (magnitude) `PD |1 - 2 e^(-TI/T1) + e^(-TR/T1)| e^(-TE/T2)`; spoiled GRE `PD sin a (1 - E1)/(1 - E1 cos a) e^(-TE/T2*)`; fat-sat multiplies fat pools by 0.05; blood: flow void (SE) / inflow (GRE) via a per-class flow factor (schematic); post-Gd uses a schematic `t1_gd` column. Presets (editable TR / TE / TI / FA, fat-sat, Gd): T1 SE, T2 FSE, PD SE, PD fat-sat, T2 fat-sat, STIR, FLAIR, T2* GRE, T1 spoiled GRE, T1 SE post-Gd, T1 fat-sat post-Gd; auto level (reference = max over non-fluid, non-flow classes) + W/L sliders. Optional synthetic noise (CT HU sigma / MR Rician) and blur (mm), default OFF, labelled "synthetic" on the image.
- **Tissue table + verification status (honest).** 33 classes, 15 references; statuses per row: `verified_abstract` (number or formula read in a PubMed abstract this session: de Bazelaire 2004 3 T values, Rooney 2007 T1 = 0.583 B0^0.382 (WM) / 0.857 B0^0.376 (GM) / 1.35 B0^0.340 (blood) s and CSF 4.3 s -> 681 / 998 / 1549 ms at 1.5 T, Pickhardt 2013 L1 trabecular 110 / 145 / 160 / 200 HU thresholds, Lamba 2014 water 0 / air -1000), `secondary_checked` (liver 586 / 46 ms, spleen 1057 / 79 ms, muscle 1008 / 44 ms at 1.5 T found in secondary tables that cite the primary; primary table not read), `derived` (3 T value shortened by the paper's own mean 21 %, or blends), `recalled_unverified` (UNVERIFIED: PMID checked, number recalled -- most CT HU rows, fat, skin, cartilage, marrow, synovial ...) and `assumption`. PubMed-checked PMIDs: Bottomley 1984 6482839, Gold 2004 15269023, de Bazelaire 2004 14990831, Stanisz 2005 16086319, Rooney 2007 17260370, Wansapura 1999 10232510, Schneider 2000 10701515, Lamba 2014 25341139 (PMC5015439: full text read, the HU tables are images, not in the text), Schreiber 2011 21655899, Pickhardt 2013 23588747, Woodard & White 1986 3801800, Hounsfield 1973 4757352; ICRU 44 is a book (not in PubMed, not re-read). The Gold / Bottomley / Woodard / Schneider NUMBERS are not in their abstracts and were not read (no full text reachable): treat the rows citing them as UNVERIFIED. The Wansapura abstract's T2 values are internally inconsistent and are not used.
- **Mapping (`mapping_rules` in the JSON; first match wins on category + "id name" regex; identical rules run in `scripts/clinical/q226_mapping_report.py` and in the add-on; a test compares JS and Python for every structure of every page).** Reports `data/derived/Q226_mapping_{vhm,vhf,zan_m,zan_f,zan_vhm,base_f}.json`: own male 593 structures / 0 unassigned / 17 classes, own female 630 / 0 / 18, Z male base 2 966 / 7 / 26, Z female fitted 2 942 / 7 / 26, Z male fitted 2 966 / 7 / 26, female base 2 940 / 7 / 26. Unassigned (drawn as generic soft tissue HU 40, T1 1000 / T2 60, flagged in the report): gingiva, greater / lesser omentum, nasal mucosa, pleura, soft palate, uvula. Coarse by design: every bone that is not long / tubular / skull is "flat_irregular"; the own brain is one structure (no GM / WM split); Z central structures are split gray / white by name; kidney and spleen exist on the own female only (own male and Z male lack kidneys).
- **UI.** Toolbar button "Imaging" opens the split screen: LEFT the 3D model with its Cut plane / slab (the existing Cut mode is switched on, axial preset at ~ 68 % of the body height), RIGHT the images. Layout by window: side by side (landscape >= 520 px short side), stacked (portrait tablet, 3D on top), TABS 3D / Image on phones (both orientations); draggable divider; header button cycles auto / side / stacked / tabs; "Controls" hides the control block. Views: Cut plane (oblique = the current cut plane) + axial / coronal / sagittal through the crosshair (MPR 2x2, or one view); radiological orientation (axial from the feet, patient R on screen left; coronal from the front; sagittal anterior left), letters R/L/A/P/S/I (also combinations for oblique planes), scale bar in mm, FOV and mm/px in every view, crosshair linked to the 3D plane (moving the plane keeps the crosshair in the plane; clicking in an orthogonal view moves the cut plane through the point; dragging in the cut view moves the crosshair), cursor / tap readout (tissue class | structure name [id] | HU or % signal | atlas x y z), FOV presets 150-1800 mm + wheel / pinch zoom + shift- or right-drag pan, resolution 256-512^2, PNG export. Controls: CT / MRI, window or sequence + TR/TE/TI/FA, slab, view, noise / blur; on short panels (< 860 px) the controls become four tabs (Contrast / Slab / View / More) so the images keep the room. Touch targets >= 36 px on small screens, no horizontal overflow.
- **Performance** (headless Chromium + swiftshader on a busy 4-core box, so conservative): 512x512 axial slice 17-41 ms on the own male and 17-31 ms on the Z female (coronal / sagittal 25-85 ms), 25 sub-slices 0.4-0.65 s; first full-resolution view 110-650 ms after the plane changes; quick pass (<= 224^2, 5 sub-slices) while dragging, 40 ms debounce. Geometry preparation 0.3-0.8 s + worker start (a few seconds under load, dominated by the page's own software-GL frames).
- **Verification.** Harness `scripts/clinical/q226_check.py ROOT PAGE own|zan OUT_PREFIX THREE_JS [--viewports all] [--shots] [--numeric vhm|zan_f] [--record NAME]` (headless Chromium, `--use-gl=swiftshader`, three.js r128 from npm for the own pages): opens Imaging, checks page / console errors and failed requests, horizontal overflow, split mode, touch-target sizes, timing, screenshots, numeric checks on real meshes. 6 viewports (1440x900, 1024x640, 820x1180, 1180x820, 390x844, 844x390): **0 page errors, 0 failed requests, no horizontal overflow on the own male (build/q226/viewer_m_hr) and the Z female fitted (build/q226/viewer_zan_female)**; smoke (1440x900 + 390x844) on own female, Z male base, Z male fitted, female base in `data/derived/Q226_browser_smoke_*.json` (the only console message there is the pre-existing 404 of the optional `clinical_needle_tool.js` on Z male fitted / female base, which have no needle files; 0 page errors). Numeric check on the real meshes (`data/derived/Q226_numeric_{vhm,zan_f}.json`): femoral mid-shaft slice = 63 % cortical / 37 % yellow-marrow canal, 685 mm2 (own male; 530 mm2 Z female), femoral head end = cancellous interior without canal, rectus femoris / vastus lateralis = 100 % muscle (52 HU), liver 100 % liver (60 HU), abdominal aorta 100 % arterial blood (45 HU), lung -800 HU. Screenshots `build/q226_renders/` (m_* own male, zf_* Z female: CT bone window MPR, CT soft, T1, T2, STIR, 25 mm MIP, single view, at every viewport incl. the phone layout; build/ is not in git). Tests `tests/test_q226.py` (33 collected: 31 run + 2 opt-in browser tests `Q226_BROWSER=1 Q226_THREE_JS=...`; the browser results are recorded in `data/derived/Q226_browser_{vhm,zan_f}.json` = the 6-viewport runs, `Q226_browser_interact_{vhm,zan_f}.json` = clicks / taps / buttons at 1440x900 + 390x844, `Q226_numeric_{vhm,vhf,zan_f}.json`): table schema + citations + statuses, windows / sequences, rules vs classes, mapping coverage reports (>= 99 %), JS == Python classification on all pages, MR / CT equations (closed forms, STIR / FLAIR nulling, fat-sat factor, T2* decay, Gd contrast, flow), kernel on synthetic meshes (sphere / cylinder areas within 6 %, cortex / canal split, canal only in the shaft, orientation labels, MIP >= avg >= MinIP, slab sees a 20 mm sphere only to 20 mm), staging, templates carry only the hook, chaining onto the needle add-on, recorded real-mesh numeric (femur shaft / end, muscle, liver, kidney + spleen on the own female, aorta, lung, real-mesh slab ordering) + 6-viewport browser runs + the interaction run (a click in the coronal view moves the crosshair AND the page's cut plane, which keeps its axial label and slab; readout; MIP / thickness buttons; a slab set in the Cut panel is adopted; "3D slab" pushes it; close restores the page). Existing `test_clinical_q188`, `test_cut_mode_q197`, `test_viewer_template` pass (45).
- **Known limits / open issues.** Single T1 / T2 per class (no multi-exponential decay, MT, magic angle, B0 / B1, chemical shift, susceptibility, motion); the cortex / marrow / skin / baseline-fat assumptions above; own bones are one mesh per name (merged ribs / hand bones share one cortex thickness); open meshes leave a few repaired rows; thin structures (< 1 px) can disappear at coarse FOV; the 3D side shows the whole rest of the body unless "3D slab" is on, and from the default front view an axial plane is seen edge-on (orbit to see the cut face); on phones tapping the 3D model in the 3D tab opens the page's own sheets as before; no ultrasound yet. Needs the owner's review of the HU / T1 / T2 rows marked `recalled_unverified` before any use beyond teaching.
- **What the ultrasound phase (next) can reuse.** The kernel (mesh x plane segments, per-structure fill, painter order, class + structure-id rasters, worker, slab sub-slices), the structure -> class mapping rules (add acoustic columns: speed of sound, density / impedance, attenuation, scattering; interface reflection from adjacent class pairs along scan lines, which needs per-pixel neighbours the class raster already has), the geometry package / worker protocol, the split-screen / tabs layout, the MPR plane + crosshair + Cut-plane coupling, orientation labels, scale bar, readout, windowing, PNG export, the info panel and the honesty-status scheme, staging (`--imaging-only` pattern) and the check harness. New work: a probe-fan / linear-array scan-line model in the plane (beam, depth gain, attenuation, speckle as clearly synthetic), acoustic table with citations.

## Q229 (2026-10-12) -- Q226 imaging tissue table (clinical/data/imaging_tissues.json): every `recalled_unverified` value re-checked against sources that were actually read (PRIVATE clinical layer; NOT published; pages NOT re-staged)
- **What was done.** 165 numeric values (33 classes x CT HU + MRI PD / T1 / T2 / T2*) now carry a per-value `ver` block {status, sources, statistic, previous value, one-line detail}; a part's status is the weakest of its values; `verification_summary` + an honesty line (shown in the Imaging info panel) quote the totals. Statuses: `verified` (number / mean / median / range printed in a PubMed abstract or an open full-text paragraph read this session), `derived` (computed from verified numbers), `secondary_checked` (seen only in a secondary compilation / search excerpt), `assumption`, `recalled_unverified` (kept, one-line reason). Old `verified_abstract` is now `verified`.
- **Result: 32 verified, 12 derived, 5 secondary_checked, 75 assumption (mostly T2* and PD choices), 41 recalled_unverified; 11 values changed by > 10 %.** Report: `data/derived/Q229_tissue_verification.json` (per tissue and value: old / new value, % change, status, sources with PMID / DOI / PMCID, statistic the viewer uses), regenerated by `scripts/clinical/q229_tissue_verification.py` (`--check` for staleness). 31 new references added: 27 opened as PubMed records (PMID checked against the title), 3 abstracts read through the Consensus index because they are not in PubMed (Mishra 2016, Barnes 1981, Asan 2023; `pubmed_checked:false` + `opened`), and `baselice2014` (a web-search excerpt only, `opened` absent, used for `secondary_checked` only).
- **Biggest changes.** blood T2* venous 100 -> 42 ms and arterial 150 -> 254 ms (Barth 1997, in vitro 1.5 T / 23 C, B0-corrected); lung T2* 2 -> 1.4 ms (Hatabu 1999); CSF HU 5 -> 6.2; thyroid HU 85 -> 104.5 (Barnes 1981); WM HU 28 -> 33 (Mishra 2016 / Stein 2025, scanner offsets of several HU); spleen T2 79 -> 66 and fat T2 85 -> 74 (derived from the 3 T abstract + field-independent T2); muscle HU 52 -> 45.5 (Ju 2025 meta-analysis); GM T1 998 -> 1098 ms. Smaller: fat T1 270 -> 284 (Garnov 2014), liver T1 586 -> 557, spleen T1 1057 -> 1132, kidney T1 1000 -> 1056 (cortex; Damlin 2024 1.5 T MOLLI), lung HU -800 -> -844 (Wu 2021 full text), WM T1 681 -> 664, heart T1 1000 -> 992 / T2 50 -> 46, brain PD 0.70 / 0.80 -> 0.71 / 0.83 (Whittall 1997). STIR preset TI 170 -> 195 ms (0.69 x fat T1 284).
- **Field strength audit.** No code path mixes B0 (the engine only uses the table's 1.5 T numbers). In the data: kidney T1 (was 3 T x 0.79) is now a direct 1.5 T value; solid_organ T1 / T2 are flagged `assumption` (blend of 3 T numbers, pancreas at 1.5 T is ~580 ms in children); 3 T numbers are used only for T2 (nearly field independent: Johnson 1985, Stanisz 2005 abstracts) and are marked `derived` (fat, spleen, kidney, nerve, spinal cord T2; cartilage T2 range-checked only). Never for T1 or T2*.
- **What could NOT be verified, and why.** The sandbox has no egress to PMC / publisher / IT'IS pages (WebFetch DNS fails, curl 403) and the PubMed full-text tool drops tables, so the tables of Gold 2004, Stanisz 2005, Bottomley 1984, de Bazelaire 2004 (1.5 T half), Lamba 2014 and the IT'IS T1/T2 reference PDFs were not opened (only a web-search excerpt of the Sensors-2014 Table 3, kept as `secondary_checked`). Still unverified: skin, synovial, tendon, nerve T1, cartilage / fibrocartilage / disc, marrow, cortical bone, tooth, lymph node, kidney / solid organ / myocardium unenhanced HU, most PD (Woodard & White 1986 has no numbers in the abstract) and all T2*. Cancellous bone 190 HU is an `assumption` inside the verified Pickhardt thresholds (110 / 145 / 160 / 200 HU).
- **Code touched (trivial).** `clinical/imaging_tool.js`: info-table status cell appends the row's `vsum` ("2 verified; not verified: t2, t2s"), CSS `.st-verified`, legend text. `tests/test_q226.py`: STATUSES, per-value `ver` consistency (weakest-of rule, `verified` needs an opened source, `recalled_unverified` carries a "not verified" reason), report-vs-table test. Tests: `tests/test_q226.py` + `tests/test_clinical_q188.py` pass (32 + 12; 2 browser tests skipped without Q226_BROWSER).
- **Next.** Re-stage the add-on into the six build/q226 pages (`scripts/regen_imaging_q226.sh`, not done here because other agents use the tree); the Q228 ultrasound table should reuse the same `ver` block format; open the paywalled tables (Gold 2004, de Bazelaire 1.5 T, Stanisz 2005, Lamba 2014) from a machine with publisher access to turn the remaining 5 secondary / 41 recalled values into verified ones.

## Q227 (2026-10-12) -- SELECTION SETS (mark several structures, show only / hide / ghost, SAVE named sets, reset) + FILLED CUT FACE (cap) on all six pages (NOT published; build/q227/<page>/)
Owner (translated): "(1) In all models: select a structure by tap/click or from the list via search, mark several structures to display, allow SAVING this selection for the future, and RESET to show everything again. (2) In all models, in CUT mode, allow filling the space (interior) of every structure in its own colour, to make separation easier, especially in CROSS SECTION."
- **Survey (before).** Own template (three.js): `select(id)` + list (`renderList`, 400 rows, search box), `apply()` = layers (`on[cat]`), source facet (`srcOn`), isolate (`iso`: ONE selected structure), X-ray, `hdShown`, picking `pickHit` (visible meshes, cut filter), hover label, add-on hooks (`api.visible(i)` = `mesh.visible`, `api.pick` -> `pickHit`, `setOpacityOverride`, `setCategoryOn`, `three.clippingPlanes`, `onChange`), parts markers read `m.visible`. Z template (raw WebGL): `select(o)` + list (260 rows), `vis(o)` (layer, hidden, solo, cut AABB, box, side), `faded`, `hidden`, `soloLayer`, 3D isolation box, ID-pass picking (`pickable`), add-on `api.visible(i) = vis && !faded`. Neither had multi-select, saved selections, a cap on the cut, or a "show everything" that also drops isolation + hover + card (the existing toolbar "Reset view" / "reset" only moves the camera / resets everything incl. the cut in Z).
- **A. Selection sets** (`viewer/selection/{selection.js,.css,.html}`, `NMSKSelect(E)`, synced into both templates by `scripts/sync_q227.py`): a *Marked structures* section above the structure list: tick at the left of every list row, **Mark selected**, **Mark list** (every search match), Shift / Ctrl / Cmd-click or **long press (520 ms, touch)** in 3D, toolbar **Mark** / panel **Mark by clicking** (a click or tap marks instead of selecting; in Z Shift-click without a drag now reaches the click handler), removable chips with the count, amber tint on marked structures. **Show only marked** (toolbar *Only marked* <-> *Show all*), **Hide marked**, **Ghost the rest** (the structures the mode would hide are drawn at 10 % and are not pickable unless nothing solid is under the pointer). **Reset selection** (and *Show all*) = clear marks + mode + ghost + mark mode + the card + hover + the engine's own isolation (own `iso`; Z hide / fade / solo / 3D box); it does NOT touch the cut (`reset cut` does), the layers, X-ray or the source facet. A selection only adds a veto in `apply()` (own) / `vis()` (Z), so it composes with layers, source facet, X-ray, Cut + slab, the filled cut face and the parts markers (`m.visible` / `vis`); entering "Show only" or ticking from the list `reveal()`s the layer / source class / hidden-by-default flag of the marked structures (an explicit choice beats a switched-off layer). **Save / Load / Delete** named sets, **Remember my last selection** (default on, restores marks + mode), persistence = `localStorage` key `nmsk.sel.v1:<model>` (model = `own:vhm|own:vhf|zan:<variant>`: ids differ between models) with try/catch and an in-memory fallback that says so in the panel; **Export / Import** as JSON text; **Copy link** `#nmsksel=<model>~<mode>~<ghost>~<ids>` (opens the same marks, same model only). Add-on: nothing in the hook contract changed (visibility via `m.visible` / `vis`, `api.pick` still `pickHit`; ghosts are skipped by it only while ghosting).
- **B. Filled cut face** (`viewer/cut_cap/cut_cap.js`: `NMSKCapCore` pure functions + `NMSKCap(E)`; buttons *Fill cross-section* and *Look at the cut face* + a one-line result under them are in the shared cut panel `viewer/cut_mode/cut_mode.html`): CPU cross-section of the ACTUAL meshes with the plane: signed distance of the vertices (a vertex exactly on the plane counts as above), triangle/plane segments between edge points, duplicate segments dropped (double-sided duplicates would cancel in the even-odd count), **contour gaps <= 1 mm closed** (open ends of odd degree joined greedily, nearest pairs first), even-odd scanline fill per structure into an **id raster** (pixel 0.4 mm, or extent/2048 for the whole body), **painter order** = tissue rank (skin, fascia < muscle < organ/cns < cartilage/ligament < bone < nerve < vessel) then big before small so small organs/vessels/nerves are not hidden by muscle or fat; the colour texture is `palette[id]` from the structures' CURRENT display colours (tissue / source-facet colour, selection teal / marked amber, x-ray alpha), so a colour-only change recolours without a new section; a **1 px outline** per structure = the contour segments themselves as GL lines (own: `THREE.LineSegments`, Z: `gl.LINES`), a segment under a later painted structure is not drawn. Own engine: `DataTexture` quad + lines under `root` (polygonOffset, `renderOrder` 900/901, `NearestFilter`); Z engine: textured quad program (`cprog`) drawn after the anatomy with blend + polygon offset, the id texture (pid bytes) is also drawn in the **ID pass and the depth pass** so a click / hover on the cap names the structure and "Place on model" lands on the plane; the quantised geometry kept in `BIN` is dequantised on demand per structure that the plane touches. With a slice (Q218) a second cap is built at the far face (`kn.p + c = th`). **Click the cap -> that structure is selected and its card opens; hover shows its name** (own: ray vs plane + id raster before the mesh hit; Z: GL id pass). **Look at the cut face** = camera on the removed side along the kept normal (poles: anterior at the top), framed on the cap extent. Debounce / throttle: a plane move hides the stale cap at once and rebuilds 90 ms after the last event (a rebuild is ~0.03-0.1 s, so no Web Worker); layer / X-ray / selection changes poll at 4 Hz (Z) or from `apply()` (own); the cap is off by default and remembered as a preference (`nmsk-capfill`). Structures drawn at < 20 % opacity (ghost / faded) are not cut (they must not hide what is under them). With the cap on, the plane's tint polygon is not drawn over it (`cut-nofill`).
- **Leaks (meshes are NOT watertight)**: rows with an odd number of crossings are counted per structure; <= 12 % odd rows and runs <= 30 rows -> repaired from the nearest valid row; otherwise the structure is **outline only** (parity sanity test, nothing wrong is filled). `scripts/q227_cap_stats.js PAGE kind name OUT` (same JS as the page) cuts every structure of a page (worst case, nothing hidden) with 13 planes (axial through the femoral shaft, thigh, forearm, thorax, 5 axial %, median sagittal, +-60 mm sagittal, mid coronal): `data/derived/Q227_cap_stats_{own_m,own_f,zan_m,zan_f,base_f,base_m}.json`. Totals over the 13 planes (structures cut / filled / outline-only / too thin; odd rows inside FILLED structures; open contour ends before -> after the 1 mm closing; mean / max ms in node): own male 866 / 841 / 15 / 10; 0.25 %; 628 -> 306; 31 / 86 ms. own female 944 / 936 / 8 / 0; 0.16 %; 358 -> 202; 35 / 103. Z male fitted 3297 / 2991 / 250 / 56; 0.16 %; 1022 -> 868; 40 / 99. Z female fitted 3469 / 3134 / 255 / 80; 0.12 %; 1070 -> 882; 31 / 61. base female 3534 / 3163 / 294 / 77; 0.20 %; 1328 -> 1032; 39 / 118. base male 3589 / 3203 / 298 / 88; 0.21 %; 1344 -> 1044; 45 / 118. Outline-only = open sheets and tubes (own: 1.7 % / 0.9 % of the structures cut, mostly fascia, plantar aponeurosis, a few muscles; Z: 7.4-8.3 %: fascia 129-133 of 153-169 cut, skin patches 12-21, 63-103 vessels, joint capsules, viscera sheets) -- they keep the outline.
- **Performance.** `NMSKCapCore.build` for the whole body, nothing hidden, 13 planes: mean 31-45 ms, max 61-118 ms in node (table above); in headless Chromium (swiftshader, a busy 4-core machine) the cut face of a landmark plane took 25-190 ms on the own pages and 25-310 ms on the Z pages (first touch of a plane that reaches many structures up to ~1 s under load: the quantised geometry of each newly touched structure is dequantised once, then cached) -- the own-page target < 0.5 s is met everywhere (`cap_build_under_500ms` check on every page); no Web Worker was needed. A plane drag hides the stale cap at once and rebuilds 90 ms after the last move.
- **Phones / tablets / desktop** (`scripts/zanatomy/q227_check.py ROOT PAGE own|zan PREFIX THREE_JS NAME --json ...`, runner `scripts/zanatomy/q227_check_all.sh PAGE THREE_JS [merge]`, JSON `data/derived/Q227_browser_check_<page>.json`, screenshots `build/q227_renders/<page>_<viewport>_*.png` incl. `_cap_femoral_shaft|thigh|forearm|thorax.png` on desktop and phone, `_cap_femoral_shaft.png` on the other viewports; headless Chromium, `--use-gl=swiftshader`, three.js r128 from npm): **six pages x six viewports (desktop 1440x900, laptop 1024x640, tablet 820x1180, tablet landscape 1180x820, phone 390x844, phone landscape 844x390) = 36 runs, 1770 checks, all pass, 0 page errors.** Checks per run (47-58): no horizontal scroll; touch targets of the selection panel / ticks / chips >= 38 px where the phone layout is on (measured min 38); list ticks -> chips + count -> Show only marked shows EXACTLY the marked set (via `api.visible`) -> Ghost keeps the rest drawn (rule "ghost") -> Hide marked -> back to all; composition: a layer toggle hides the marked structures of that layer and shows them again, X-ray, the Source facet colouring (own), Parts markers (fewer visible markers in "only" than with everything); cut + selection: the cap contains only marked structures, a 5 mm slice has a far face, none without; **Reset selection clears marks / mode / ghost / mark mode, shows more than the marked ones and leaves the cut and the fill on**; Mark by clicking, Shift click / Ctrl click (desktop), Mark toolbar tap + a real CDP **long press** (phones) marks / unmarks, a plain click still selects; Save -> listed + in `localStorage` under `nmsk.sel.v1:<model>` -> Reset -> Load restores -> Export is JSON with the set -> Delete -> Import brings it back -> link; desktop only: the remembered last selection comes back after a reload, a `#nmsksel=` link in the address restores it with `localStorage` cleared, and a page whose storage throws (init script) works from memory, says so, and exports; the cut face: Fill button state, `fill off` shows no cap, filled / outline-only counts shown under the button, **the rendered pixel on the cap equals the cap texel (>= 85 % of 40 sampled texels; Z exact, max deviation 0) and, on the own pages, the structure's display colour**, the cap changes the picture, **a click on the cap selects the structure under it and its card opens, hover names it** (own `#hover`, Z hovered), 'Look at the cut face' faces the plane (|cos| > 0.995), X-ray changes the cap (recolour or rebuild), fill off removes it, exit cut clears it. Phone note: the open cut panel covers the model on a phone, so 'Look at the cut face' folds it to its header (the arrow reopens it) and frames the face in the free part of the canvas (own `lookAt`/Z `lookAt` take the free region).
- **Tests** `tests/test_q227.py` (43 pass; the build/ and JSON-dependent ones skip where those are absent): shared blocks verbatim in both templates + `scripts/sync_q227.py --check`, cut-panel buttons, engine wiring strings (own quad + lines + `capHitAt`; Z colour / ID / depth passes, polygon offset, Shift-click path, 4 Hz poll), fragments contain nothing private; cap core under node on synthetic meshes (cube / sphere / torus / torus seen from the side = analytic areas within 1-2 %, open cube = outline only with every row odd and nothing painted, an open mesh whose missing face crosses no pixel row is still filled right, a 0.4 mm tear is closed by the 1 mm gap closing (area 1600 exact) and repaired by row copy when the closing is off, duplicated faces do not cancel, painter order vessel over muscle + pick lookup, colours follow alpha / colour changes in place, ghosts / misses are not cut, outline segments lie in the plane); the selection controller under node with a mock DOM (marks, rules for only / hide / ghost, mark button, Mark list / Mark selected, save / load / delete + the stored JSON, export / import incl. bad input and unknown ids, link round trip, Shift / Ctrl / Cmd / Mark-mode clicks, last mark leaves "only", blocked storage = memory fallback + note, remember-last + link-in-address beats it + other-model link ignored); the six stats files; the six browser-check JSONs (0 errors, no failed check); the six regenerated pages (blocks present, geo files sha256-identical to the sources, `_verify` OK). With `test_cut_mode_q197` (22), `test_q220` (22), `test_clinical_q188`, `test_source_facet_q189`, `test_hidden_default_q184`, `test_viewer_template`, `test_build_zan_atlas_viewer` all passing.
- **Regeneration, no geometry recomputed** `Q218_OUT=build/q227 SRC_own_m=build/q224/viewer_m_hr SRC_own_f=build/q224/viewer_f_hr SRC_zan_m=build/q225/viewer_zan_vhm SRC_zan_f=build/q225/viewer_zan_female SRC_base_f=build/q222/viewer_base_female SRC_base_m=build/q222/viewer_zan_atlas scripts/regen_cut_q218.sh` -> `build/q227/{viewer_m_hr,viewer_f_hr,viewer_zan_vhm,viewer_zan_female,viewer_base_female,viewer_zan_atlas}/` (page + geo files + clinical_* + `parts_data.json`; `_verify/*.json` all OK: geo files byte-identical to the sources). The Z male / female sources are `build/q225/viewer_zan_*` as they stood at 07:24 (Q225 was still running its in-bone / pair audits); **if Q225 rebuilds them, re-run the same command** (own pages only need it when q224 changes) and `scripts/q227_cap_stats.js` (see the file header) for the stats.
