The cap is part of the scene (own: two objects under `root`; Z: drawn after the anatomy and before the add-on's `onAfterDraw`), so the add-on's overlays draw on top; the needle's own picking sees the meshes behind the plane exactly as before. The own pages in the check carried the needle add-on (`clinical_needle_tool.js`): `#t-needle` present, no page error with the add-on loaded.
- **Known limits.** The cap is the mesh section, not a segmentation: structures that overlap on the model overlap in the fill (the later painted wins, rank then size); a structure that is below 20 % opacity (ghost / faded / x-ray skin) is not filled; outline-only structures (open sheets / tubes: Z fascia, skin patches, many vessels) show a contour but no fill (a closed-contour fill would be wrong); nearest-neighbour texels (0.4 mm, or extent / 2048 for whole-body sagittal / coronal planes ~ 0.9 mm) -- the outline is exact, the fill edge steps when zoomed in a lot; a plane that is not axis-aligned works the same (arbitrary plane basis) but the raster covers the whole body extent in the plane; the cap hides the interior surfaces of the cut structures (that is its purpose) so the 'inside' of a muscle can no longer be seen through the cut while the fill is on; Mark by clicking / Shift-click select nothing (they mark); the persistent selection is per browser + model (ids differ between models; unknown ids are dropped on load, never an error); the share link only works where the page address can be read and the same model is open (artifact frames may hide the hash: use Export); the in-memory fallback is lost on close; the existing toolbar *Reset view* / *reset* still means camera (own) / everything incl. the cut (Z), the new *Reset selection* / *Show all* is the selection reset; on a phone the Z toolbar wraps into two rows when a selection is active; 'Colour by source' (own) colours both the mesh and the cap, marked structures are tinted amber over it.
- Files: `viewer/selection/*`, `viewer/cut_cap/cut_cap.js`, `viewer/cut_mode/{cut_mode.html,cut_mode.js,cut_mode.css}` (two buttons, `cut-nofill`), `scripts/sync_q227.py`, `scripts/q227_cap_stats.js`, `scripts/zanatomy/{q227_check.py,q227_check_all.sh}`, `tests/test_q227.py`, `data/derived/Q227_cap_stats_{page}.json`, `data/derived/Q227_browser_check_{page}.json`, `docs/VIEWER_README.md` (two paragraphs), the two templates (own: selection veto / tint / ghost in `apply()`, `pickHit` ghost filter + `capHitAt`, list rows, quad + lines; Z: `vis()` veto, `colOf` tint, ghost pass, cap programs + ID / depth pass, `loop()` poll, Shift-click), `build/q227/<page>/` and `build/q227_renders/` (git-ignored).

## Q228 (2026-10-12) -- ULTRASOUND mode, phase 2 of the imaging layer: simulated B-mode from the meshes (PRIVATE clinical add-on; NOT published; pages build/q228/<dir>, all six)
Owner (translated): "Also an ULTRASOUND mode where I can decide on a position, and from there 2 options: (1) the transducer at 90 degrees at the centre of the screen and around it, by TILT, to the various directions; (2) a position including TILT, then CONTINUOUS imaging along the displayed organ at a defined distance [3 mm - 5 cm], in a matrix of 3 to 9."
- **What it is, and is not.** A SIMULATION from the segmented meshes, never a scan: badge in the panel header ("Simulated from meshes -- not an ultrasound"), burned into every image (wrapped on thumbnails) and the PNG export, plus an Info panel (conventions, equations, the whole acoustic table with status colours and sources, honest limits). No wave solver, no beam forming, no Doppler (colour Doppler out of scope), no refraction.
- **Files / licensing / loader (like Q188 and Q226, nothing in a public template).** `clinical/ultrasound_tool.js` (engine + UI, ~1230 lines) and `clinical/data/ultrasound_tissues.json` (acoustic table with citations + status per row, probe presets, textures, artefact notes), the owner's PRIVATE layer (`clinical/LICENSE_PRIVATE.md` now names them), staged BESIDE the page as `clinical_ultrasound_tool.js` + `clinical_ultrasound_tissues.json` by `scripts/clinical/stage_clinical_files.py --ultrasound DIR` (also stages the two imaging files it needs; `--remove` takes all nine clinical names away). **The templates are NOT touched (Q227 owns them): the imaging file loads the ultrasound file as an optional companion** (`loadCompanions()` in `clinical/imaging_tool.js`: `<script src=SCRIPT_BASE + "clinical_ultrasound_tool.js">`, silent if absent; the already published placeholder of the same name is simply replaced). Changes to `imaging_tool.js` (all backward compatible, Q226 tests unchanged): `NMSKImagingLib` is exported in the browser too; the attach returns shared services `{lib, ensure() (geometry package + worker + table), runSlice, boneParams, isOpen, close, addClickHandler}`; `runSlice` is serialised (one worker job slot, two modes may not interleave); the kernel accepts an optional `R.mask` (structures to leave out, skin never) for "honour hidden structures"; the page API has ONE click-handler slot that the needle add-on already owns, so the chain installs a dispatcher (companion handlers first while armed, then the needle handler unchanged). **Re-publishing = upload `clinical_imaging_tool.js` (new loader, NOT the one published in Q230) + `clinical_ultrasound_tool.js` + `clinical_ultrasound_tissues.json` (+ `clinical_imaging_tissues.json`) to the pages the owner chooses.**
- **Stage commands (all six pages, ~1 s, no geometry recomputed).** `scripts/regen_ultrasound_q228.sh [own_m own_f zan_m zan_f zan_vhm base_f]` copies the latest staged imaging pages (`Q228_SRC_ROOT`, default `build/q230`: current templates, unified names, Q225 Z fits) to `build/q228/<dir>/` and stages the four files on top; `Q228_REBUILD=1` instead rebuilds from the published pages through `regen_imaging_q226.sh` (SRC_<page>, `Q226_ALLOW_Q225=1`). Verify: `python3 scripts/clinical/q228_check.py build/q228/viewer_m_hr index.html own build/q228_renders/m THREE_JS --viewports all --shots --scenes --interact --perf --record vhm` (Z pages `zan`; THREE_JS = three.js r128 `three.min.js` for the own pages).
- **Placement.** "Place on skin" arms the next click / tap on the 3D model (also phones: the 3D tab has a "Place probe" button): ray from `api.ray(e)`, own nearest-hit test against ALL skin triangles of the packed geometry (works on both engines, honours the Cut plane / slab: hits on removed parts are skipped, Z pages give no hit point through `api.pick`), normal = area-weighted average of the skin triangle normals within 15 mm (linear fall-off), oriented outward; default = skin at the centre of the 3D view; "Zoom to probe". Probe types linear 38 / 44 / 50 mm, convex 60 / 65 / 70 mm (R 60 mm), sector 20 / 22 / 25 mm (90 deg fan); frequency 3.5 / 5 / 7.5 / 12 MHz; depth 2-15 cm; longitudinal (marker cranial, screen left = cranial) / transverse (marker to patient right, screen left = patient right) presets + free rotation about the normal; gain, far TGC, focus, dynamic range; speckle / textures / reverberation / noise switches. Beam axis = -N' where **N' = the face normal after tilt**; tilt = rigid rotation of the whole probe about the contact point, axis N x t, t = cos(dir) u + sin(dir) e (dir 0 = handle towards the far end = rocking inside the image plane, 90 / 270 = heel / toe = fanning, the plane swings sideways); the 3D view shows the probe (body, face, red marker), the selected image plane filled, the others as outlines, the beam axis (overlay in THREE or raw WebGL, no template change).
- **Mode 1 (perpendicular + tilt star).** 3 x 3 grid: centre = the main image (large), ring = 8 tilts (angle 5-30 deg, default 15; away / away+heel / heel / toward+heel / toward / toward+toe / toe / away+toe), each labelled; clicking a ring image makes it the main image (the old main takes its cell) and moves the 3D plane. **Mode 2 (position + tilt + sweep).** Tilt 0-45 deg in any direction + rotation, N = 3..9 frames (matrix 3x1, 2x2, 3x2, 4x2, 3x3), step 3-50 mm (or total 3-50 mm), frame k at k x step along the plane normal (perpendicular to the image plane), optional centring / reverse, every frame labelled `#k +offset mm`, matrix or single view, cine (1-8 fps) and a scroll slider; the face of each frame is re-seated on the skin by sliding along the beam axis (the plane is unchanged, planes stay parallel); "follow organ": pick a structure in 3D (or take the one under the cursor) -> the probe rotation about N is chosen so that the sweep direction is as close as possible to that structure's PCA long axis.
- **Physics (all in `simulate()`, node-testable).** Slice kernel of Q226 for the plane (class raster + structure ids, 320-480 px); straight beam lines (linear parallel, convex / sector fan) sampled at ds <= 0.8 px; at every class change specular reflection R = ((Z2-Z1)/(Z2+Z1))^2 x angle factor f + (1-f) exp(-theta^2/2 sigma^2) (theta from the gradient of the smoothed log-impedance; per-class sigma 12-25 deg, diffuse floor), transmission (1-R) (two-way), sub-sample interface position + sub-sample attenuation split; attenuation 10^(-alpha f L / 10); class backscatter relative to liver (qualitative); nominal TGC (0.6 dB/cm/MHz two-way + user far gain) so fluid -> posterior enhancement, bone / lung / air -> shadow, **no separate switches**; resolution axial 1.25 lambda, lateral 1.2 lambda F/D growing away from the focus; A-line reverberation (2x, 3x depth) behind R >= 0.4 reflectors; seeded synthetic speckle (value noise, Rayleigh statistics, attached to the sweep volume), muscle perimysium lines (Worley network in the cross-section of the muscle's PCA axis) and tendon fibrils, tendon / muscle / nerve anisotropy (brightness vs angle between beam and fibre axis), optional system noise; air between face and skin = coupling gel up to 12 mm (else lost contact = black, "NO SKIN CONTACT"); an air band < 12 mm that tissue follows along a beam is treated as fat (the Z skin is 250 overlapping patches, the kernel's even-odd union leaves air-labelled gaps between skin layers: without this fix the Z images were black below 1 cm). Display: dB re liver, liver level at 55 % of the grey range, gain / dynamic range re-map instantly; marker left, depth scale (cm) at the right edge, probe footprint at the top, orientation letters, readout (tissue class | structure | depth | lateral | echo dB | atlas xyz).
- **Acoustic table + verification (HONEST).** 33 classes (the imaging class keys, mapping rules shared with the imaging mode): Z, c, alpha, echogenicity, speckle contrast, specular sigma, texture, anisotropy, status + sources per row. **Only one number was read in a PubMed abstract this session: cortical bone attenuation 13.3 +- 0.97 dB/cm across ~8 mm human skull samples (Pinton 2012, PMID 22225300; the abstract gives no frequency, its use as a per-MHz slope is an ASSUMPTION) = the single `verified_abstract` row.** Compilations Goss 1978 (PMID 361793) and 1980 (PMID 11683186) and Culjat 2010 (PMID 20510184) exist in PubMed but their tables are not in the abstracts and were not read; Duck 1990 and Szabo 2004 are books (not in PubMed, not re-read) and the IT'IS database (itis.swiss) is not reachable from this environment. The impedances named by the owner (soft tissue 1.6, fat 1.34, muscle 1.7, blood 1.61, cortical bone 7.8, air 0.0004, liver 1.65, kidney 1.62, tendon 1.9 MRayl) are `owner_supplied`; every other number is `recalled_unverified` or `assumption` (echogenicity = qualitative textbook ordering) and needs the owner's review (a Q229-style source pass) before any use beyond teaching.
- **UI.** Toolbar button "Ultrasound" next to "Imaging" (closing one opens the other's slot: one split screen at a time); same framework as the imaging mode (own `#us-root`, body classes `nmsk-us us-side|us-stack|us-tab`, draggable divider, header cycles auto / side / stacked / tabs, "Controls" hides the control block, controls become four tabs Probe / Mode / Image / More on panels < 1000 px tall); tablet portrait stacked, phones tabs 3D / Image (landscape phone starts with the controls folded); Z pages share the layout rules (`us-z`). Works with Cut mode (probe visible through the cut, picks respect the plane), "honour hidden structures" (reads `api.visible(i)` per structure, tolerated when absent, default OFF = the whole body is imaged as in a patient), the page selection (own picking; the page API exposes no selected structure).
- **Verification.** `tests/test_q228.py` (22 + 4 opt-in browser): table covers all 33 classes / citations / the single verified row / owner impedances, probe presets; node geometry: perpendicular probe normal == skin normal (200 random normals, < 1e-3 deg), tilt star 9 frames with angles exact to < 1e-3 deg about the right axes (rock keeps the short axis, fan keeps the long axis), sweep offsets exactly k x spacing for N = 3..9 and spacing 3, 7.5, 10, 25, 50 mm with planes parallel and perpendicular to the image plane, matrix dims, follow-organ rotation, skin normal on a synthetic sphere (hit 0.2 mm, normal < 2 deg) + cut plane; physics on synthetic rasters: bone slab = surface echo > 25 dB above the muscle at that depth and shadow < -25 dB, cyst anechoic (< -25 dB) with > 4 dB posterior enhancement, bone echo falls monotonically with incidence angle, 12 MHz > 10 dB more attenuation at 7 cm and finer resolution (axial = 1.25 lambda exactly), fan geometries, seeded speckle (same seed identical, other seed different, off = none), tendon anisotropy (> 10 dB between 0 and 25 deg), reverberation at 2x / 3x depth, lost contact, noise determinism; staging, templates mention nothing of ultrasound, licence, loader chain keeps the needle click handler; recorded browser runs `data/derived/Q228_browser_{vhm,zan_f,own_f,zan_m,zan_vhm,base_f}.json` (+ `Q228_scenes_{vhm,zan_f}.json`): see below. Existing `test_q226`, `test_clinical_q188`, `test_cut_mode_q197`, `test_viewer_template` pass (77).
- **Browser results (headless Chromium + swiftshader, `scripts/clinical/q228_check.py`, three.js r128 for the own pages).** 6 viewports (1440x900, 1024x640, 820x1180, 1180x820, 390x844, 844x390) on the OWN MALE (`build/q228/viewer_m_hr`) and the Z FEMALE FITTED (`viewer_zan_female`): **0 page errors, 0 console errors, 0 failed requests, no horizontal overflow, 0 touch targets < 28 px, layout us-side / us-stack / us-tab as designed** (`Q228_browser_{vhm,zan_f}.json`); smoke 1440x900 + 390x844 on own female, Z male base, Z male fitted, female base: 0 errors (the only 404 is the optional `clinical_needle_tool.js` on Z male fitted / female base, which have no needle files, recorded as `optional_404`, same as Q226). Interaction runs (1440x900 + 390x844, real mouse clicks / touch taps, both engines): a click / tap on the 3D skin places the probe (moved 82-95 mm), a ring image becomes the big central cell, sweep N = 6 step 12 mm -> offsets exactly 0..60 mm with labels `#k +off mm`, matrix 3 x 2 (2 x 3 portrait), cine visits the frames, follow organ on the femur -> sweep direction vs PCA axis cos 0.95-0.9999, hidden-structures mode and Cut mode OK, Info table 34 rows, close restores the page. **Performance (own male, best of 3)**: one 480 px frame = slice kernel 12 ms + physics 47 ms (60 ms; Z female 48 ms); 9-frame matrix 211-272 ms (linear, 5 cm) and 294-494 ms (convex, 15 cm); the 9-frame star on open 580-670 ms wall at every viewport (first frame ~ 160 ms incl. worker warm-up; Z first open up to ~ 1.1 s). (An earlier run showed 4.4 s matrices: that was the page's own software-GL redraw, fixed by drawing the overlay once per refresh.) - **Known limits / open issues.** Straight-ray model: no refraction / edge shadowing, no speed-of-sound displacement (c = 1540 m/s everywhere), no side lobes, mirror image, multiple scattering (reverberation only as 2x / 3x A-lines behind R >= 0.4), no gas in bowel (the stomach / bowel mesh is one tissue), no elevation slice thickness (single plane), no harmonics / compounding, no compression, no motion, no Doppler / elastography. Mesh-driven: fascia / septa meshes are one-pixel lines (bright stair-steps on oblique planes); baseline fat (space no structure covers) sets muscle-fat contrast; bone cortex / canal are the Q226 modelled values; kidneys exist only on the own female; the air-band fill (12 mm) is a heuristic for the Z skin patches; tilt frames keep the picked point as pivot and the seat range is +-18 mm (a steep tilt on strongly curved skin can lose contact = black, flagged); sweep frames are re-seated by sliding along the beam. Heel / toe: which short-axis side faces the examiner depends on where he stands (labels are probe-relative). Follow-organ uses the global PCA axis (curved organs only roughly). "Single" sweep view has no filmstrip (scroll slider / cine instead). The probe is drawn at true size (44 mm): at full-body zoom it is small, "Zoom to probe". The acoustic numbers are unverified teaching values except the one marked above (needs the owner's review).

## Q232 (2026-10-13) -- SELECTION: INVERT + per-group display states (fade / hide / ghost / x-ray / highlight), presets, helpers, keys on all six pages (NOT published; build/q232/<page>/)
Owner (translated): "When selecting an organ or organs there must be an option to MARK them, or to SWAP and mark everything else. So I can mark the selected ones, swap so that the rest become the selected ones and apply FADE to them, plus all the other relevant options." Extends Q227; the Q227 buttons, saved sets and links keep working.
- **Model** (`viewer/selection/selection.js`, synced into both templates by `scripts/sync_q227.py`): two groups, *Selected* (= the marked) and *Others*, each with a display state `show | fade | hide | ghost | xray` (+ `hl` highlight for Selected only). `fade` = the **Fade opacity** slider (0-100 %, default 15 %; 0 % = not drawn at all), `ghost` = 10 % (own) / 12 % (Z), picked last, `xray` = the X-ray look for that group only (own: muscle 34 %, other non-bone 50 %, bone solid; Z: the x-ray preset's per-layer opacities), `hl` = solid in the **Highlight colour** (default #ffb000, colour input). Q227 mapping: *Show only marked* = Selected show + Others hide, *Hide marked* = Selected hide + Others show, *Ghost the rest* turns the hidden group into `ghost`; `state().mode/ghost` are still derived, Q227 sets / links / exports load unchanged. Controller API additions: `look(id)` (state of the structure's group), `rule(id)` (Q227 view), `tinted(id)`, `fadeAlpha()`, `hlHex()`, `translucent()`, `setGroup(g,state)`, `preset(k)`, `invert()`, `markVisible()`, `markCategory(key,on)`, `onKey(e)`; engine adaptor additions `eligible()`, `categories()`, `idsOfCategory(k)`.
- **Invert** (panel *Invert*, toolbar *Invert*, key I): marks = everything ELIGIBLE minus the marked. Eligible = what the layer toggles, default-hidden flags, the Source facet (own) and the side filter / solo layer / hidden set (Z) leave shown; the selection itself, the single-structure isolate, the cut plane and the Z 3D box are ignored. The old marks are kept as "left out" (chips `not X` with a + to mark that one too, plus a summary chip, instead of thousands of chips); Invert again swaps back; edits while inverted act on the complement (unmark = leave out); the amber tint is off while inverted. Nothing eligible to mark / everything already marked = a message, no change.
- **UI**: 'Selected [Show][Fade][Hide][Highlight][Ghost][X-ray]' / 'Others [Show][Fade][Hide][Ghost][X-ray]' (3-column grid, pressed state = the current state, clicking the active state returns to Show), Fade slider + %, Highlight colour + *Tint marked*, presets **Isolate selected / Fade others / Fade selected / Hide selected / Highlight selected** (toggle), then the Q227 buttons. Helpers: **Mark all visible**, **Mark layer / Unmark layer** (select of the layers), Clear marks. Keys (only while something is marked, never while typing, no Ctrl/Alt/Meta): **I** invert, **F** fade others (Shift+F selected), **H** hide selected (Shift+H hide others = isolate). Without marks the Z page's own i / f / h (isolate box / fade / hide the open structure) are untouched; with marks the selection keys win (capture-phase listener).
- **Saved sets / export / link**: a set is stored as `{ids, mode, ghost, ss, os, fade, hl, inv}`; when inverted `ids` = the LEFT-OUT ids and `inv:true` ("inverse of", listed as `name (n, inverse)`), re-evaluated against what is eligible when loaded. Export JSON carries it; link `#nmsksel=model~mode~ghost~ids~sel.oth.fade%.inv.hexcolour` (5th field new, 4-field Q227 links still open). Unknown ids dropped; bad states / fade / colour in an import are ignored.
- **Engines.** Own (`apply()`): hide = `m.visible=false` (not drawn, not picked by `pickHit`, no cap item); fade = `material.opacity = min(.., fade)` (the open structure stays solid like a ghost does; faded meshes stay pickable as today); xray / highlight (colour + emissive, opacity 1 unless an add-on risk map overrides); the cap items read `m.material.opacity` so a faded structure's cut face is drawn at its opacity (< 20 %: no face, as for ghosts since Q227) and hidden ones have none. Z: `vis()` veto for hide (no draw, no ID pass, no cap), new transparent passes `fadeSel / xraySel / ghostOnly` (alpha from `selAlpha`), `hlOnly` solid pass in the highlight colour whatever the layer opacity, `isThin()` makes faint ones pickable only when nothing solid is under the pointer (same as the per-structure fade), cap items use the same alpha / colour. A per-structure card fade (Z) keeps its own 0.18 and wins.
- **Add-ons (contract unchanged: `api.visible(i)`, `api.pick`, `cut()/setCut()/cutSlab()`, `three.clippingPlanes()`, `onChange`, `setOpacityOverride`, `setCategoryOn`; add-ons tolerate absence).** `api.visible(i)`: hidden (incl. fade 0 %) = false; faded / ghost / x-ray / highlighted = true (own: `m.visible`; Z: `vis(o) && !faded.has(o)` as before). The needle tool reads it for targets / halos / picks (hidden structures are not targets) and composes its risk opacity override with the fade (the lower opacity wins); ultrasound reads it as a mask (hidden = not in the simulated B-mode, faded still imaged); imaging (CT / MRI) draws every tissue regardless of selection state (it never calls `api.visible`).
- **Not done / limits.** Ghost is a very faint translucent surface, not an outline-only wire (no cheap honest outline for open sheets; the cut-face outline exists only in cut mode). Z phone: with marks the toolbar wraps to three rows (Mark, Only marked, Invert, Parts pills). The fill/cap of a structure below 20 % opacity is not drawn (Q227 rule, so default 15 % fade has no cut face; raise the slider to 20 % or more to see faded cut faces at that opacity). Z Q233 note (template item (1) of the Q233 section, SUBJECT_LABELS / source class for the HRA organs) is NOT part of Q232.

Outputs: `data/derived/Q235_cvh_to_vhf_transform.json` (both side conventions, residuals per landmark region, organ cross-check, chirality evidence), `Q235_report_{own_f,comb_f,base_f}.json` (every gate of every structure, volumes, order checks, not shipped by choice), `Q235_vertex_diff_{f,comb_f}.json` (ship diff, 0 unlisted), `Q235_pagecheck.json`, `Q235_render_{own_f,comb_f}_perineum_*.png`; tests `tests/test_q235_cvh.py` (20), `tests/test_q235_pages.py` (12); code `scripts/anatomy/q235/{cvh,register,fit,solid,structs,place,core,evidence,register_own,render_check,render_check_z}.py`, `scripts/transfer/q235_own_f.py`, `scripts/zanatomy/q235_z_female.py`, `scripts/q235_build_all.sh`, `scripts/regen_q235.sh`.
- **KEY FINDING (corrects third_party/cvh_wu2015/README): the 'open sheets' are CLOSED solids.** Counted per undirected edge on the unwelded triangles, 14 of the 47 meshes used here are closed (the README / structures.json counted DIRECTED edges, so any mesh with inconsistent triangle winding read 'open', `volume_cm3: null`). Re-orienting the triangles (vertex order only, no vertex moves, `solid.py`) gives volumes that an independent ray-parity Monte-Carlo check confirms (clitoris 1.92 vs 1.96 +- 0.04 cm3 in the CVH frame, vestibular bulbs 0.49 / 0.54, Bartholin 0.38 / 0.21, bulbospongiosus 2.83, ischiocavernosus 1.73 / 1.55, perineal body 3.73 + 0.65, ...). Four (superficial / deep transverse perineal, urethral sphincter proper, perineal body) touch themselves along 1-3 four-triangle edges (reported, volume = signed volume, MC-checked). So NO shell / cap was needed except the urethral lumen: the closed 'Bladder and urethral lumen' mesh is cut at the bladder neck (cross-section 114 -> 9.65 mm2) by a plane perpendicular to the submucous-layer axis and the distal 24.2 mm (a collapsed 1 mm2 channel, 0.029 cm3) is capped by a flat 9.65 mm2 disc ('capped' on the card). README + NOTICE amended.
- **Registration (bones only, rigid + uniform scale, bidirectional trimmed closest-point fit; the CVH pelvic bone is cropped, a one-way ICP inflates the scale):** CVH pelvic bone + closed sacrum / coccyx onto HER hip bones / sacrum, scale x1.107 (CVH pelvis 10 % smaller; the residual vs scale has a clear optimum, 1.00 -> 3.6 mm, 1.10 -> 1.7 mm; all pelvic-tilt starts converge). Residual median / p90 mm: all bone vertices 1.80 / 4.35; pubic symphysis 1.42 / 2.79; ischiopubic arch 1.79 / 3.25; ischial tuberosities 1.87 / 3.60; sacrum + coccyx 1.74 / 4.84 (coccyx alone 5.5). A local refit of the inferior pelvis gains 0.1 mm: not used. Soft organs of the CVH woman differ from the page's (symmetric NN median mm): bladder wall 15.0, vaginal wall vs HRA vagina 10.8, uterus 25.0, ovaries 23.9, rectum 7.2, external anal sphincter 10.7, levator 6.3, ischiocavernosus 6.9, bulbospongiosus 5.4, deep perineal 20.3: individual differences (and the HRA organs' own error), NOT corrected (a soft-landmark fit would push the clitoris / urethra 10 mm into the symphysis, which is 3 mm away). Combined: the same transform (her frame; the Z body is fitted to her skeleton), residual against the page's Z bones 2.65 / 7.65 (inferior pelvis 3.2 / 10.3; symphysis region 12: the Z hip bones lack the medial pubic faces). Base female: own fit scale x0.957, all 3.15 / 7.92, inferior pelvis 3.1 / 8.5.

## Q237 (2026-10-14) -- LEFT / RIGHT: which structures are paired, how asymmetric the two sides are, mirror FILL of missing / defective sides, display-only SYMMETRIC VIEW (agent; NOT published, hub untouched; pages build/q237/<page dir>)
Owner (translated): 'Check which organs are paired and which are not. For those that are, create symmetry in the models between the two sides.' Interpretation (instruction of the main session): our reconstructed models are INDIVIDUALS and really asymmetric, so MEASURED data is never overwritten by a mirror image. Four parts: (1) classify every structure of the six pages, (2) quantify the asymmetry of every pair, (3) fill a MISSING or LISTED-DEFECT side as the mirror of the opposite (good) side, fitted to this side's bones, behind the signed-distance guards, (4) a display-only 'Symmetric view' option. Code: `scripts/anatomy/q237/{core,pairing,fill,run_fill,build_sidecar,after_counts,report_md,pagecheck,render_filled}.py`, `scripts/transfer/q237_own.py`, `scripts/zanatomy/q237_z.py`, `scripts/sync_symview_q237.py`, `viewer/symview/*`, `scripts/q237_build_all.sh`, `scripts/regen_q237.sh`; data `data/derived/Q237_{pairing.json,pairing.md,after_counts.json,fill_<page>.json,vertex_diff_<page>.json,pagecheck.json}` + renders `Q237_render_*.png`.
- **Midsagittal plane per model** (`core.fit_midsagittal`): the plane {n.x = d} that makes the AXIAL SKELETON (ribs, sternum, vertebrae, sacrum, pelvis, shoulder girdle, skull; 12-30 k surface samples) most self-symmetric (median + 75th percentile of the nearest-surface distance of the plane-reflected cloud; offset search then Nelder-Mead over offset / yaw / roll). The first try (a plane through the centroids of the L/R LIMB-bone pairs) is NOT used: the limbs lie differently in these bodies (offset up to 100 mm), it gave d = +13 / +26 mm and a 1.1 / 8.2 degree tilt for the VH male / female. Base = exactly symmetric (x = 0 to 0.1 mm, tilt 0.03 deg); VH male tilt 1.76 deg (roll, d -11.3 mm at the origin; the vertebral column leans 0.0305 x y), VH female 1.16 deg, d -8.4; Combined male 0.82 deg / -6.1, Combined female 0.70 / -7.1; reflection residual (median / p95) 2.6-3.0 / 9-11 mm on the individuals, 1.6 / 4.5 on Base (the sampling noise floor); midline bones (vertebrae, sacrum, sternum, hyoid, skull base) median offset 0.1-1.8 mm, p95 5-10 mm (natural spinal curve).
- **Classification** (units = structure groups: all meshes of one name + side; `_zfill`, `_q212` and numbered pieces join their structure; twins by `_l` / `_r`, `left` / `right` words and Z aliases (word overlap + mirrored position); lateralised = curated list `core.LATERAL` (liver, spleen, stomach, bowel, heart and great vessels, lungs / bronchi / pulmonary vessels, carotid / subclavian / vagus / phrenic / gonadal / renal-vein ..., thymus lobes, oesophagus) + single meshes far off the midline + paired organs whose sides differ by design; midline = crosses the plane (>= 8 mm each side) or centroid within 12 mm): 
  - Imaging-based male: 607 meshes -> **paired 192 / midline 45 / lateralised 18 / unmatched 34** (24 one side missing, 10 one side much smaller); plane tilt 1.76 deg, offset d -11.3 mm; flagged pairs 103 (major 34); paired after the fill 204
  - Imaging-based female: 679 meshes -> **paired 218 / midline 55 / lateralised 21 / unmatched 42** (28 one side missing, 14 one side much smaller); plane tilt 1.16 deg, offset d -8.4 mm; flagged pairs 129 (major 49); paired after the fill 239
  - Combined male: 2966 meshes -> **paired 1212 / midline 217 / lateralised 192 / unmatched 27** (2 one side missing, 25 one side much smaller); plane tilt 0.82 deg, offset d -6.1 mm; flagged pairs 329 (major 116); paired after the fill 1239
  - Combined female: 2992 meshes -> **paired 1219 / midline 222 / lateralised 192 / unmatched 32** (2 one side missing, 30 one side much smaller); plane tilt 0.70 deg, offset d -7.1 mm; flagged pairs 310 (major 114); paired after the fill 1251
  - Base male: 2966 meshes -> **paired 1238 / midline 212 / lateralised 195 / unmatched 3** (2 one side missing, 1 one side much smaller); plane tilt 0.03 deg, offset d -0.1 mm; flagged pairs 10 (major 4); paired after the fill 1241
  - Base female: 2961 meshes -> **paired 1238 / midline 209 / lateralised 193 / unmatched 4** (2 one side missing, 2 one side much smaller); plane tilt 0.03 deg, offset d -0.1 mm; flagged pairs 12 (major 5); paired after the fill 1242
  Unmatched = one side missing (a real gap; on the own pages mostly forearm / hand muscles of ONE side that were Z-filled once, plus fascia / retinacula) or one side much smaller (ratio < 0.5 or > 2: truncated CT-block muscles such as his transversus abdominis 0.35, external oblique 0.42, internal oblique 0.40, his thumb ray metacarpals 0.49). Lists per page in `Q237_pairing.md` section 5 / 6, every structure with class and reason in the JSON.
- **Asymmetry** (every matched pair incl. the paired organs that are lateralised by design: 5,611 pairs on the six pages): the LEFT group reflected (winding reversed) and compared with the right: volume ratio R/L (exact for closed meshes, voxel solid of the sealed surface for open ones, area for sheets), centroid offset, median symmetric surface distance and HD95 from 2,000 samples per side, rigid ICP residual (translation / rotation / msd / hd95 after alignment), IoU of the voxel solids after the plane mirroring and after the rigid alignment. Owner flags: ratio < 0.8 or > 1.25, IoU < 0.6 (flag on the ALIGNED IoU: a posed limb is posture, not shape; fascia / skin are sheets and structures thinner than 4 mm are not IoU-flagged: a 1 mm misalignment of a 2 mm tube is IoU 0.3), missing sides. Flagged pairs / major (ratio < 0.67 or > 1.5 or IoU < 0.3): VH male 103 / 34, VH female 129 / 49, Combined male 329 / 116, Combined female 310 / 114, Base male 10 / 4, Base female 12 / 5. Base is symmetric to its own noise (flagged 1 %); the fitted pages are not (25 %), which is the per-bone fit and posture. Top asymmetries (volume x size): VH male: pronator quadratus R/L 4.8 (Z-filled), transversus abdominis 0.35, external oblique 0.42, flexor digitorum superficialis 2.8, internal oblique 0.40, extensor indicis 3.3, thumb ray (metacarpals 0.49, adductor pollicis 0.64, EPB 1.8); VH female: pronator quadratus 5.0, extensor indicis 3.2, vastus lateralis 1.53 (transferred), ECRL 2.2, carpals 1.9 (her left hand Z-filled), left forearm; Combined: posterior intermuscular septum of the leg R/L 5.7 / 4.9 (the left one is a Z source defect), intercostal muscles / nerves / arteries (IoU), transversus abdominis, external oblique; Base: ascending lumbar vein 2.6, internal oblique 0.78, scalenus anterior 0.6. The audits' known cases (his thumb ray, her left forearm / wrist, piriformis left, left elbow, carpal ligaments) show up as expected (`Q237_pairing.md` section 8); they are NOT touched.
- **FILL** (`fill.py`, `run_fill.py`; the whole point is: never replace validly measured data). Two kinds of candidate: **A** a MISSING side (opposite = this body's own measured / rule-based data on the own pages; any Z-Anatomy structure on the Z pages; no listed defect) and **B** a LISTED DEFECT (Q198 / Q204 audit severity >= 2 on one side, 0 on the other, from `build/q225_raw*/Q204_regions_*.json`) whose defective side is NOT this body's own data (own pages: Z-filled or transferred; Z pages: Z-fitted estimates). Own-page B candidates are all `recommendation` (the defective side is measured / rule-based, or the opposite is itself a Z fill); a mirror of an estimate is never made on the own pages (use the Z counterpart, Q214 pipeline). Pipeline per structure: reflect about the model's plane (winding reversed) -> rigid + uniform scale from the NEIGHBOURING bones (up to 3 bones within 30 mm, the mirrored bones of the source side onto the same bones of this side, symmetric trimmed ICP `q235/register.py`, 5 starts) -> bounded conform step (<= 6 mm: out of bones, inside the skin; displacement field smoothed; 3 passes) -> GUARDS (signed distances, the Q214 / Q216 pipeline's gates): all vertices inside the skin and >= 1 mm; muscle / fascia / ligament: <= 8 % of the vertices and <= 5 mm inside bone (they attach); vessel / nerve / organ: none inside bone and >= 1 mm clear; muscle overlap with other muscles <= 60 % of its volume (2 mm voxels, identical to the Q204 audit: correlation 0.998 with its `overlap_pct`); bone registration median <= 4 mm / p90 <= 9 mm; scale 0.85-1.18; rotation <= 30 deg. Z muscles overlap / embed by design: there the mirror is also accepted when no worse than the clean side it copies (+2 points; recorded as `relaxed_to_source`). ANY failed guard = held with the reason.
  - Imaging-based male: shipped 2 (coracoclavicular_ligament L>R [A; bones 2.19/5.26 mm], tibial_n L>R [A; bones 2.48/4.48 mm]); held 0 (none); recommendation only 48
  - Imaging-based female: shipped 7 (coracoclavicular_ligament R>L [A; bones 1.86/4.17 mm], femoral_n R>L [A; bones 2.61/4.37 mm], tibial_n R>L [A; bones 2.46/4.21 mm], femoral_a R>L [A; bones 2.61/4.37 mm], femoral_v R>L [A; bones 2.61/4.37 mm], popliteal_a R>L [A; bones 1.97/4.13 mm], popliteal_v R>L [A; bones 2.46/4.21 mm]); held 0 (none); recommendation only 42
  - Combined male: shipped 7 (lateral_intermuscular_septum_of_arm L>R [A; bones 1.49/2.61 mm], transverse_intermuscular_septum_of_leg L>R [A; bones 1.72/3.66 mm], ventral_parts_of_lateral_intertransversarii_lumborum_muscles R>L [B; bones 1.22/2.26 mm], superior_gluteal_n R>L [B; bones 1.94/3.67 mm], ophthalmic_artery L>R [B; bones 0.66/2.02 mm], lateral_femoral_cutaneous_n R>L [B; bones 1.43/3.06 mm], radial_collateral_artery R>L [B; bones 2.39/5.98 mm]); held 8 (opponens_pollicis, teres_major, sternocleidomastoid, temporoparietalis_muscle, extensor_carpi_ulnaris, tibialis_anterior, posterior_femoral_cutaneous_n, sural_n); recommendation only 0
  - Combined female: shipped 9 (lateral_intermuscular_septum_of_arm L>R [A; bones 0.9/1.91 mm], transverse_intermuscular_septum_of_leg L>R [A; bones 1.16/2.32 mm], lateral_thoracic_artery R>L [B; bones 2.41/8.5 mm], posterior_circumflex_humeral_vein L>R [B; bones 1.78/4.59 mm], obturator_internus R>L [B; bones 1.99/3.96 mm], gemellus_superior R>L [B; bones 1.99/3.96 mm], ophthalmic_artery L>R [B; bones 0.64/1.97 mm], soleus R>L [B; bones 1.14/2.29 mm], lumbrical_muscles_of_foot L>R [B; bones 1.01/3.58 mm]); held 8 (dorsal_parts_of_lateral_intertransversarii_lumborum_muscles, flexor_carpi_ulnaris, abductor_hallucis, abductor_digiti_minimi_hand, extensor_carpi_radialis_brevis, gastrocnemius, opponens_digiti_minimi, sural_n); recommendation only 0
  - Base male: shipped 4 (lateral_intermuscular_septum_of_arm L>R [A; bones 0.98/2.1 mm], posterior_intermuscular_septum_of_leg L>R [A; bones 1.05/2.24 mm], medial_pterygoid R>L [B; bones 0.74/1.73 mm], ophthalmic_artery L>R [B; bones 0.84/2.07 mm]); held 3 (maxillary_nerve, abductor_digiti_minimi_hand, flocculus); recommendation only 0
  - Base female: shipped 4 (lateral_intermuscular_septum_of_arm L>R [A; bones 0.98/2.1 mm], posterior_intermuscular_septum_of_leg L>R [A; bones 1.05/2.24 mm], medial_pterygoid R>L [B; bones 0.74/1.73 mm], ophthalmic_artery L>R [B; bones 0.84/2.07 mm]); held 3 (maxillary_nerve, abductor_digiti_minimi_hand, flocculus); recommendation only 0
  Per-structure fit error (bone residual median / p90, scale, rotation), conform mean / max, every guard number and the volume / area are in `Q237_fill_<page>.json` and on each card. Held reasons are almost all the skin gate (superficial muscles whose Z shape reaches the skin within < 1 mm and cannot be moved the 3-5 mm needed within the 6 mm bound) or the 60 % overlap. Own pages: only his tibial nerve R and coracoclavicular ligament R, her femoral n / a / v, popliteal a / v, tibial n, coracoclavicular ligament L (her page has the femoral / popliteal vessels and the femoral / tibial nerves of the RIGHT leg only) were added; 0 held. Ship diff `Q237_vertex_diff_*.json`: 0 unlisted on all six (own: 607 -> 609 / 679 -> 686 entries, everything else byte-identical; Z: 2 added + 2-7 replaced structures, 2,959-2,985 untouched).
- **Source class / labels**: own template: SUBJECT_LABELS `mirror_q237` ('MIRROR IMAGE of the opposite side, fitted to this side's bones; not measured on this side: ...'), `classifySource` -> class `mirrored_opposite` ('Mirrored from the opposite side', hex 0xE0583A, say 'Mirror image of the opposite side, fitted to this side's bones - not measured on this side.'), python mirror `scripts/audit_q189_model_separation.classify`. The Z template lists no source classes (the cards carry `procedural_badge`), so nothing was added there; every new / replaced Z structure's badge starts 'MIRROR IMAGE of the opposite side, fitted to this side's bones; NOT measured on this side (Q237)'. The own-page facet shows the class (his 2, hers 7); a mirrored structure is never a source for another mirror (OWN_DATA excludes it).
- **SYMMETRIC VIEW** (display only; `viewer/symview/{symview.css,symview.html,symview.js,glue_own.js,glue_zan.js}`, single source synced into BOTH templates by `scripts/sync_symview_q237.py` between `SYMVIEW <kind> begin/end` markers + a few idempotent engine-hook lines at fixed anchors; per page a sidecar `symmetry_q237.json` = the plane + the twins classified paired (lateralised organs, midline, one-sided structures and twins sharing a mesh id are not in it), fetched like `parts_data.json` (absent = no control)). Control: a select in the tool bar 'Symmetric view: off / Mirror right onto left / Mirror left onto right' + banner 'Symmetric view: not measured data' (+ Off button); it draws the MIRRORED copy of the chosen side's paired structures and hides the other side's originals while on. **Own engine (three.js)**: the same geometry under the reflection matrix (three.js flips the winding for a negative determinant), cloned material following the source's colour / opacity / visibility, `clippingPlanes` = the cut planes (verified: every copy carries them), the cut-cap fill gets the reflected copies, originals hidden in `changeHooks`. **Z engine (WebGL)**: the main vertex shader reflects position AND normal about the plane when `uSymOn` (the fragment shader's `uClip` / `uClip2` / box tests run on the reflected position), `draw()` paints the scene a second time for the source side (`frontFace(CW)`), AABB tests with the reflected box, vetoes in `vis()`, cap items for the copies. Both engines work with CUT mode (default sagittal cut removes the right half: 'mirror left onto right' leaves the picture unchanged, diff <= 2 %, 'mirror right onto left' changes it 5-9 %) and on the phone (select in view, no horizontal scroll). Limits: a mirrored copy cannot be picked / selected (clicking it does nothing; the cut-cap click selects its source); sheets (skin / fascia) mirror like everything else.
- **Build** (no full builds, no template drift): `scripts/q237_build_all.sh` (~35 min under load): pairing -> `q237_own.py own_m / own_f` (bundles `build/viewer_{m,f}_hr_q237`) and `q237_z.py comb_m / comb_f / base_m / base_f` (pre-pages `build/q237_pre/<dir>` from the COMMITTED template) -> regenerated risk tables (`clinical/data/risk_{vhm,vhf,zan_f,zan_m}.json`: the mirrored vessels / nerves are needle-risk entries; Combined female calibres of the replaced vessels changed) + staging -> `scripts/regen_q237.sh` (= `regen_q232.sh` incl. `set_titles_q231.py`, then the sidecars) with PRIVATE template copies `build/q237_pre/_templates_sym` (HEAD + `sync_symview_q237.py`), because another agent's uncommitted Q236 edits sit in the shared working-tree templates: new env `NMSK_TEMPLATE_DIR` (default viewer/) in `rebuild_own_html_from_built.py`, `zanatomy/rebuild_html_from_built.py`, `verify_regen_q218.py`. `build/q237/_verify/*.json`: OK on all six (data literals and geo files identical to the pre-pages, page = template + data). **A later template re-sync IS needed** once the Q236 labels UI is committed: run `python3 scripts/sync_symview_q237.py` (no-op if the markers are there) and `Q237_TPL_WORKTREE=1 scripts/regen_q237.sh` (geometry untouched) so every page carries both changes; the Q236 labels layer is not aware of the hidden originals / mirrored copies (their label anchors stay at the original structures).
- **Browser checks** (headless Chromium swiftshader, desktop 1400 x 900 + phone 390 x 844, `Q237_pagecheck.json`, three.js `/tmp/three_x/package/build/three.min.js`): all six pages 0 page errors (only the aborted Google-Fonts request), no horizontal scroll, control present with its three choices and inside the viewport, both mirror modes switch (src / hidden counts, banner), cut + sym in both engines; renders `Q237_render_{own_m,own_f,comb_f,base_m}_symmetric_*.png` (+ `_cut_` = Cut mode with the Symmetric view) and `Q237_render_own_{f_filled_femoral_a_l,f_filled_popliteal_v_l,m_filled_tibial_n_r}.png` (the selected mirrored structure with 'Colour by source', muscles off, its card).

## Q236 (2026-10-14) -- STRUCTURE LABELS: names / abbreviations on the structures, callouts with leader lines outside the body, legend window, on all six pages (agent; NOT published, hub untouched; pages build/q236/{viewer_m_hr,viewer_f_hr,viewer_zan_vhm,viewer_zan_female,viewer_base_female,viewer_zan_atlas})

If abbreviations are used, provide a window listing them with control of the window size and the font size."
- **Shared block** `viewer/labels/{labels.js,labels.html,labels.css}` synced verbatim into BOTH templates by `scripts/sync_labels_q236.py` (`--check`; markers `LABELS css/html/js begin/end`, same pattern as parts_ui / selection). Controller `NMSKLabels(E)` + the pure geometry `NMSKLabelsCore` (summed-area body mask, callout solver; testable under node). It only READS the engine (no geometry / material / colour / visibility / cut change; test_q236_labels pins that); the one engine action is the 'Fill cut face' button, which presses the existing cut-panel feature. Per-page abbreviation table: `<script type="application/json" id="nmsk-abbrev">` between `NMSK-ABBREV begin/end` (template placeholder `{}`), filled by `make_abbrevs.py --inject`.
- **Engine adaptor** (documented at the top of labels.js; both templates implement it, `labelsCtl = NMSKLabels({...})` next to the Selection / Cap controllers): `structures() alphas() color(i) geometry(i) view() idImage(all,w) cut() capHit(o,d) fillCut() ray(x,y) selected() marked() select(id) bg() obstacles() canvasRect() redraw() toolbar toolClass isPhone()`, plus the engine calls `labelsCtl.update()` at the end of `draw()`, `hover(id)` on pointer hover and `dirty()` on layer / fade / hide changes. **Own engine**: ID image = a low-resolution `WebGLRenderTarget` (<= 640 px wide), every visible mesh swapped to a flat-colour `MeshBasicMaterial` (same cut planes / slab as the screen, materials restored, cap quads and markers hidden) -> `readRenderTargetPixels`. **Z engine**: the existing picking pass `renderIds(all, depth, sc)` gets a scale argument (renders into the lower-left sc*W x sc*H corner of the picking buffer, the cut face names its structure there too), `pickKey = null` afterwards. No ID buffer is new on either side; both honour the clip plane / slab / isolation exactly like the screen.
- **Modes** (panel `Labels` on the toolbar, key **L** cycles): Off / Selected (selected + hovered + marked structures; Selection integration) / Visible (the N largest visible, N = **Max labels** slider 3-120, default 24, phones 12) / All (the largest 160 on screen). Text: **Full name** (side words stripped, `(R)` / `(L)` marks switchable) / **Abbreviation**. **Callouts**: Auto (inline where the label fits on its own structure, outside with a leader where crowded; hysteresis against flicker) / Outside / Inline (labels that would overlap are left out). Font size 9-22, colour Structure (the colour the structure is DRAWN in, so Source-facet / mark / highlight colours are never fought, darkened / lightened until contrast >= 4.2 on the canvas background) / Neutral, halo (paint-order stroke) for dark and light backgrounds, **Hide labels of hidden-behind structures** option. Defaults: Off (opt-in), settings persisted in `localStorage` `nmsk.labels.v1` (try/catch everywhere, in-memory fallback, hostile / out-of-range stored values clamped).
- **Visibility / occlusion**: per refresh `alphas()` (0 = hidden / layer off / source facet / isolate / side filter; opacity otherwise; labels need >= 20 %), then ONE ID image of the opaque structures (>= 60 %) and, only when a translucent one (20-60 %) is drawn, a second image of everything: a structure is visible iff its own image has pixels of it (so a structure clipped away by the cut, fully behind others, or hidden behind opaque ones gets no label; one seen through a translucent skin does). Cut mode: 'in CUT mode a structure counts if any part is on the kept side' falls out of the clipped ID image. Labelled set = forced (selected / hovered / marked) + the N with the most visible pixels (x1.35 hysteresis for those already labelled, x0.15 for the skin layer so organs win, one label per name + side: Z-fill continuation meshes are not labelled twice). 600+ structures: the ID image is <= 640 x 400, the statistics are one pass, anchors only for the N chosen.
- **Anchors**: 96 area-weighted surface samples per structure (triangle centroids, made lazily in <= 9 ms slices without a new ID image); the anchor = the sample that is VISIBLE (its pixel in the ID image names the structure), on the camera's side, nearest to the visible-pixel centroid, kept as a 3D point so the dot sticks to the model between refreshes; fallback = the visible pixel nearest to the centroid (2D, refreshed with the next ID image). **CUT mode** (filled cross-section on, camera on the removed side): the pixel ray -> `capHit` (the existing cut-face id raster) -> the anchor lies ON the structure's cut face (kind `cut`); 'Fill cut face' button appears in the panel when the face is off. Refresh throttle: gap = 6 x its own measured cost (0.17 - 6 s) + a settle refresh after the camera stops; forced-set changes at most every 0.4 s; the per-frame work is only re-projection + layout (3-70 ms of JS).
- **Layout** (`NMSKLabelsCore.solve`): each callout goes along the outward normal of the body's bounding ellipse to the nearest place whose box touches neither the silhouette (summed-area table, 3 px margin), a HUD panel nor the frame (7 candidate directions, hysteresis toward the previous place); boxes are pulled apart (priority-weighted, selected first), a vertical sweep packs full columns, swaps that shorten two leaders (which removes their crossing) and candidate moves untangle leader lines; labels that still do not fit are left out (lowest priority first), zoomed-in views fall back to the frame edge (never under a HUD panel). Leader = line from the nearest point of the label box to the anchor + dot; deterministic; eased in screen space while orbiting (solved only when the view / items / settings changed). HUD obstacles are given by the adaptor (own: tools, cut panel, needle panel, part card, axes, scale bar, frame note; Z: brand, toolbar, rail, info card, view buttons, cut / needle panels) plus the two label windows themselves.
- **Abbreviations** (`scripts/anatomy/q236/abbrev.py`, `make_abbrevs.py`, `data/anatomy/abbreviations.json` = convention + KNOWN table + RESERVED + every page's map; applied by `regen_q236.sh` -> `make_abbrevs.py --inject`): `BASE[-R|-L]` ('RF-R' = rectus femoris, right; 'SCM-L'). **Established** abbreviations only from the KNOWN table (each one a standard published one: SCM, ECRL / ECRB / ECU, FCR / FCU, FDS / FDP, FPL, EPL / EPB, APL, BF, ST, SM, RF, VL / VM, TA / TP, EHL, TFL, GMax / GMed / GMin, ACL / PCL / MCL / LCL, ATFL / PTFL / CFL, IVC / SVC, CCA / ICA / ECA, RA / LA / RV / LV, AIN / PIN, ITB, vertebrae C3 / L4 / T12, discs 'L4/5' 'T12/L1', ...; an abbreviation inside the atlas name itself, e.g. '(ACL)', is taken when its letters are the initials of the name's words; a qualifier like '(foot)' blocks the hand-muscle abbreviation); everything else is **generated** (flag g = 1, italic in the legend): initials of the content words ('TSEPL'), first three letters of a single word ('Coc'); collisions lengthen the generated members ('BiFe'), never a known one; reserved clinical abbreviations (RA / LV / ...) are never given to something else (rectus abdominis is 'ReAb', right atrium 'RA'); the same cleaned name + side on several ids gets '.2' '.3'. Per page: 572 / 655 / 2966 / 2992 / 2961 / 2966 structures, 199-408 established, all unique (case-insensitive). The table is derived from the page's own names / sides, so a rebuilt page never carries a stale table; a page without the block falls back to plain generated initials.
- **Legend window** ('Abbreviation list' in the panel): draggable header, corner resize grip, **S / M / L** size buttons (250x220 / 350x340 / 520x520), own font size (A- / A+ and slider 10-24 px), search (abbreviation or name), **On screen** (what is labelled now) / **All structures** (first 300 rows, refine by search), colour chip, generated ones italic, click a row = select the structure, hover a row = emphasise its label on screen; footer states the convention. Floating windows keep clear of HUD panels (default place chosen by least overlap, a window the user has not moved steps aside when the cut panel opens; a moved window keeps its place in localStorage); **bottom sheets on phones AND on stages narrower than 560 px** (the tablet layout of the own template has a 270 px stage): one sheet at a time, S / M / L = 30 / 44 / 72 vh, the Details / list sheets of the page hide the labels panel (the existing `sheet-open` convention).

Obstacle-bound cases (a floating panel covering half of a label column, a phone-sized stage) keep 0 overlaps / 0 body hits but leaders cross more (the checks allow max(3, n/3) resp. max(4, n/2)).
- **Performance** (software GL, so absolute numbers are CPU rasterisation of ~2-3 M triangles, not a GPU; `scripts/anatomy/q236/perf_check.py`, `data/derived/Q236_perf_*.json`, 1366x768, 8 orbit steps, nothing else running): Imaging-based male: 1.88 s / step with labels Off, 2.51 s Visible (24, +34 %), 2.74 s All (53 labels, +46 %); ID image 0.39 s, per-frame label layout 3 ms (Visible) / 71 ms (All, swiftshader JS). The ID image is vertex-bound (same triangles, tiny viewport), so on a GPU its cost is about one frame's vertex work, taken at most every 0.17 s and at most about 1/7 of the time (gap = 6 x its own cost); between refreshes the labels follow the model by 3D anchors and cost only the layout.

## Q239 (2026-10-15) -- IMAGING (CT / MRI) + ULTRASOUND not visible on the published pages: robust loading (code + tissue tables pasted INTO the page), visible diagnostics, always-present buttons (agent; NOT published, hub untouched; test pages build/q239/<page dir>, made from build/q238 + `stage_clinical_files.py --ultrasound`)

- **What the metrics showed (before)**: (1) one label per pixel = binary edges (body-outline jaggedness 0.26 px own / 0.68 px Z, a 0.25 px pan flips pixels: linearity residual 0.51), 43 (own) / 105 (Z) single-pixel label islands per 100k body px; (2) open meshes: Z pelvis / knee / shoulder have ~70 / 36 / 9 odd scan lines per slice (cartilage caps, cord, small arteries, mesentery folds); the repair copied the row above and smeared; (3) CT / MRI noise from one global PRNG: re-rendering the same plane (window change) re-draws it (corr 0.00), a panned plane shows a new pattern, adjacent planes uncorrelated; (4) ultrasound: one NEW speckle seed per star frame (1 deg tilt -> speckle corr 0.49 in a homogeneous block) and the lattice sat in plane coordinates (stuck to the screen when the plane moved); system noise per screen pixel; (5) ultrasound windows cut the body: the exterior flood started at ALL four window edges, so on the Combined Female the default abdomen placement showed signal in 12 % of the fan (the rest 'air' inside the body), (6) the medullary canal switched on at ramp w = 0.5 (a step of ~350 HU between neighbouring slices at the shaft ends).
- **What changed (all in clinical/imaging_tool.js, clinical/ultrasound_tool.js; versions q226.3 / q228.3)**: kernel `R.ss` = supersampling (3 x 3 at rest, 1 while dragging = the old preview; budget ss^2 x sub-slices <= 64; `LIB.chooseSS`) with `fine` label image: pixel value = AREA-weighted mean of the class values (partial volume: boundary pixels are mixes, thin structures faint lines, edges move continuously with the plane, slab MIP / avg built on area values); sheets drawn one image pixel wide at 1/ss positioning; small enclosed gaps (<= 1.5 px^2) inside the body take the class that surrounds them most (counted: `holesFilled`, status line), cracks and real cavities stay as the fat baseline; odd scan lines are repaired by the best agreement of the span sets with the nearest consistent row above and below (candidates: drop one crossing / add one partner on a neighbour outline; nothing else is invented); mask clearing per bounding box (cost ~ painted area); canal grows continuously over the ramp (radius ~ w); slab sub-slices by the midpoint rule (<= 1 mm cells, `LIB.slabOffsets`); noise = world-position seeded unit-variance lattice noise (`LIB.gnoise`, correlation length 1.2 mm CT / 1.5 mm MR, scaled by 1/sqrt(thickness / length) on averaged slabs), optional MRI coil bias (`LIB.biasField`, smooth plane waves, 0..30 % slider 'Coil bias', default off); ultrasound: ONE seed, speckle lattice fixed in the body (reference frame = the star centre / the sweep's tilt, origin = contact point of the placement), system noise seeded by body position, `extTop` (the exterior of an ultrasound window is flooded from its top edge only); `image-rendering:auto` + high-quality smoothing for scaled canvases. ## Q245 (2026-10-15) -- RANGE-OF-MOTION VALUES of the Pose panel checked against the literature (agent; NOT published, hub untouched, viewer templates untouched; the main session rebuilds the pages)
Owner (translated): "Check the range-of-motion values against the literature." Task: every ROM value of `scripts/anatomy/q241/rom.py` / `docs/pose_rom_table.md` (each joint, DOF, both ends) with real citations, mean/SD or range, chosen bound, status; ISB axis check; thresholds of the L/R pose comparison.
- **Honest status of the evidence.** The fetch tool had NO DNS in this session (WebFetch / curl to any host failed), so only PubMed records (abstracts; PMC full text for open-access papers), Consensus (2 searches left of the month) and search-engine summaries were readable. The books (AAOS Greene & Heckman, AMA Guides, Norkin & White, Kapandji, White & Panjabi) were NEVER read. Result for the 68 range ends (34 ranges x lo/hi): **4 verified from full text** (Vairo 2012 shoulder, Baumbach 2014 ankle), **18 verified from an abstract** (Zwerus 2019 elbow, Kim 2014 wrist, Kouyoumdjian 2012 hip rotation, Cooney 1981 thumb CMC, Apti 2023 cervical, Edmondston 2012 thoracic extension; almost all ONE sample = 'single source'), **5 secondary snippet only** (Soucie 2011 hip/knee ages 20-44 from the CDC table, Roaas 1982 hip), **20 abstract only = AAOS value kept UNVERIFIED** (no number in any abstract: shoulder extension/abduction, fingers, thumb, great toe, plantarflexion, lumbar ...), **15 assumptions** (shoulder adduction, DIP, lesser toes, thoracic, inversion/eversion given to the subtalar joint ...), 6 neutral-zero definitions. Boone & Azen 1979, Roaas 1982, Soucie 2011 tables, Mallon 1991, Youdas 1992 were NOT opened (paywall / no fetch) - to verify properly someone with institutional access should read those tables.
- **Rule** (rom.py docstring + doc): hard bound = mean + 1 SD of the best adult sample whose mean and SD were read (rounded to 1 deg); mean only -> that mean (larger multi-sex sample); nothing read -> old AAOS value, labelled; soft/extended limit = mean + 2 SD where an SD was read (stored in `rom_meta` of the rig JSON, not used by the viewer: needs a template change). Passive values preferred; adult default, sexes pooled; caveat: Vairo (18-19 y athletic cadets) and Apti (18-29 y) are young.
- **23 bounds changed** (old -> new; table in the doc): shoulder flexion 180 -> 179 (170.2 +- 8.6 passive), shoulder ER -90 -> -93 / IR 70 -> 74 (Vairo: ER at side 81.4 +- 12.0, IR at 90 abd 60.7 +- 13.4), forearm pronation -80 -> -84 / supination 80 -> 91 (Zwerus), wrist extension -70 -> -76 / ulnar dev -30 -> -38 / radial 20 -> 23 (Kim), thumb CMC abduction 70 -> 42 (Cooney), hip extension -30 -> -18 and flexion 120 -> 132 (Soucie 20-44; Roaas 9.5 / 120), hip abduction 45 -> 39 (Roaas), hip rotation -45/45 -> -40/34 (Kouyoumdjian), knee flexion 135 -> 140 (Soucie), ankle dorsiflexion 20 -> 29 (Baumbach, but only 11 with the knee extended), cervical flexion/extension 45/45 -> 66/69, lateral 45 -> 50, rotation 60 -> 81 (Apti). Unchanged because supported: elbow flexion 150, wrist flexion 80, shoulder flexion ~180, C1/C2 = 50% of cervical rotation (Ishii 2004: 36.2 of ~71 deg per side). Biggest corrections: cervical range (AAOS value low), hip extension (30 vs measured 10-18), thumb CMC abduction, hip IR, ankle dorsiflexion (knee-dependent).
- **Coupled motions** (doc table): ankle DF vs knee (4 +- 7 extended vs 20 +- 9 flexed, no gain beyond 20 deg knee flexion; NOT modelled), scapulohumeral rhythm GH:ST 1.7:1 (McClure 2001) vs the model's 2:1 (1/3), shoulder ER 81 at the side vs 103-105 at 90 abduction (slider uses the arm-at-side value), hip rotation vs flexion (no significant difference, Kouyoumdjian), knee rotation 35/40/44 at 70/90/110 flexion (no DOF), cervical coupling (Ishii), lumbar coupling (Pearcy).
- **ISB (Wu 2002/2005)**: abstracts only; the recommendation texts could not be fetched, so the deviation table in the doc is from knowledge of ISB + `rig.py` and is flagged as such: hip flexion-abduction-rotation order = ISB; shoulder uses Cardan flexion-abduction-rotation (singular at 90 abd) instead of ISB Y-X-Y' (singular at arm-down), fixed 1/3 scapular share, no scapular tilt; ankle = two stacked hinges (malleolar-tip talocrural + Inman subtalar) instead of one tibia-calcaneus JCS; knee 1 DOF; spine regional sliders instead of per-level JCS; forearm axis radial head-ulnar head vs ISB ulnar Y; carrying angle, finger abduction, thumb CMC rotation missing.
- **Thresholds of the L/R pose comparison** (`Q241_pose_asymmetry.md` section 2.1, report_md.py): 5 deg limb joints = justified as the typical ceiling of the dominant/non-dominant GROUP-MEAN difference (elbow < 1, shoulder <= 4.1 Vairo, ankle none, largest of 60 measures 7.5 Macedo & Magee 2008; NOT a 95% limit - individual SD of the difference unavailable); 8 deg long-axis rotation = justified for non-athletes (3.5-4.7 dominance effect, 7.5 max) but an overhead athlete shows 12 (Biaggi 2021); forearm/finger/toe 8, wrist 5, subtalar, pelvis/spine 3, head 5 = assumptions; the cited Sadeghi 2000 / Herzog 1989 / Knutson 2005 do NOT give joint-angle tolerances (gait review, force-plate index, leg length in mm). Numbers unchanged, verdicts not recomputed.
- **Files**: `scripts/anatomy/q241/rom.py` (ROM API unchanged; new ROM_EVID, SOURCES, COUPLED, STATUS, rom_meta()), `make_rom_doc.py` (-> `docs/pose_rom_table.md`), `make_pose_rig.py` (adds `rom_meta` to the rig payload), `report_md.py` (-> `data/derived/Q241_pose_asymmetry.md`), the six `data/anatomy/pose_rig_*.json` + `data/derived/Q241_rig_*.json` rebuilt (`Q241_SRC_own_f=build/q243/viewer_f_hr Q241_SRC_comb_f=build/q243/viewer_zan_female Q241_SRC_base_f=build/q243/viewer_base_female python3 scripts/anatomy/q241/make_pose_rig.py own_m own_f comb_m comb_f base_m base_f`, 3 min), `tests/test_q245_rom_evidence.py` (9 tests: rule arithmetic, status honesty, citations, rigs carry the numbers, thresholds doc), `tests/test_q241_rom.py` (expected values updated to the Q245 bounds).
- **Tests**: test_q245 9/9, test_q241_rom/core/asym/viewer pass; `test_q241_rig.py::test_rig_matches_the_page_geometry_when_the_page_is_present[own_f|comb_f|base_f]` fail WITHOUT the Q241_SRC_* env (pre-existing since Q244: `model.py` defaults still point the three female pages at build/q238 while their rigs are built on build/q243); with the env all 20 pass. One-line fix for the main session: change the three female defaults in `scripts/anatomy/q241/model.py` SRC to the q243 dirs.
- **For the main session / owner**: the pages must be rebuilt/republished to carry the new bounds (slider ranges + `rom_meta`); the viewer could show the soft limit (a lighter band to mean + 2 SD) and couple ankle dorsiflexion to the knee angle; owner decisions: keep 'mean + 1 SD of young samples' as the hard bound or use the AAOS values again where the evidence is thin (hip extension and cervical range are the large ones).

## Q241 (2026-10-15) -- LEFT / RIGHT POSE difference (posture separated from anatomy) + JOINT POSE CONTROLS on all six pages (agent; NOT published, hub untouched; test pages build/q241/<page dir>)
Owner (translated): 'Asymmetry in tissues that should be symmetric can come from the position of the hand/leg/body. Later joints should be movable within normal limits, per joint. Create this option. Make sure the asymmetry is within a reasonable range, especially in the BASIC models, because reconstructions will be fitted onto them.' Two parts. Code: `scripts/anatomy/q241/{model,geom,skeleton,rig,rom,fk,skin,asym,run_asym,report_md,make_pose_rig,validate_pose,browser_check,preview,make_rom_doc}.py`, `viewer/pose/{pose.js,pose.html,pose.css,glue_own.js,glue_zan.js}`, `scripts/sync_pose_q241.py`, `scripts/regen_q241.sh`; data `data/anatomy/pose_rig_<page>.json` (6, 0.3-0.56 MB), `data/derived/Q241_{pose_asymmetry.json,.md, rig_<page>.json, pose_validation_<page>.json}`; doc `docs/pose_rom_table.md`; tests `tests/test_q241_{rom,core,rig,asym,viewer}.py` (36). Template edits are minimal: one POSE block (css/html/js/glue) after the SYMVIEW block, one `NMSK-POSE-RIG` placeholder next to the abbreviation table, and two hook lines in the Z template (`o.vOff = base;` in the batch builder, a posed-geometry check at the top of `capGeom`). `git pull --rebase` + stage the templates as HEAD + `python3 scripts/sync_pose_q241.py` when committing (other agents leave uncommitted edits in the same working tree).
- **PART 1 -- pose asymmetry.** Method (`asym.py`, report `data/derived/Q241_pose_asymmetry.md`): landmarks from each page's OWN bones (femoral / humeral head sphere RANSAC, transepicondylar axes with the lateral sign from radius / fibula, malleolar axis, foot frame from heel + metatarsal heads, ASIS / PSIS pelvis frame, forearm axis, palmar side from the flexor vs extensor muscles of the model); the left limb is reflected about the midsagittal plane so equal numbers = equal posture; 13 limb DOFs + fingers / toes (Z pages), per-vertebra / pelvis / skull / thorax symmetry planes, per-segment ICP of the mirrored left bones onto the right ones, and the Q237 tissue pairs re-evaluated after moving the mirrored left soft tissue by those rigid per-bone transforms (skinned, same weights as the viewer). Thresholds (ASSUMPTIONS, literature-level): 3-5 deg limb joints, 8 deg for long-axis rotations / finger / toe means, 3 deg pelvis / spine, 5 deg head. RESULT: **Base M and Base F are reasonable AND symmetric by construction** (Z-Anatomy left = mirror copy of right: 43 joint angles agree <= 0.1 deg, toes <= 4.5 deg landmark noise on tiny bones, bone surfaces 0.48 mm median / 1.9 mm p95, pelvis / spine / skull plane differences <= 0.2 deg; their A-pose is identical on both sides: shoulder abduction 10 deg, elbow 15 deg, forearm 80 deg supination, wrist radial deviation 13 deg, pelvic tilt 3.7 deg vs trunk). The asymmetries Q237 flags in the Base pages (scalenus anterior 0.60, lumbar veins 0.66, internal oblique 0.78, subcostal vein, ureters, retinae, ...) are ANATOMICAL (volume ratio, pose-invariant), none is a pose effect. So NOTHING was re-posed and no geometry changed (ship-diff 0); the Pose panel's 'Anatomical position' preset gives the strict anatomical position as a display state. Reconstructed pages are posture-asymmetric specimens (measured; not corrected): exceed tolerance Combined F wrist flexion 6.8, hip rotation -10, fingers 25 / toes 15 mean (fitted Z hand / foot bones are warped: indicative only); Combined M hip rotation 8.8, wrist -5.4; Imaging M shoulder rotation -30, elbow +22, forearm -31 (his LEFT forearm bones are a Z gap fill), hip rot 11; Imaging F shoulder rotation -13, wrist 7.5 / -8.6. Bone-driven pose normalisation of the Q237 tissue pairs: muscle centroid offset median 11.3 -> 3.7 mm (Comb F), 12.4 -> 4.3 (Comb M), 20.8 -> 5.7 (Imag M), 13.8 -> 8.0 (Imag F); IoU 0.28 -> 0.57 (Comb F; per-structure ICP upper bound 0.62), 0.21 -> 0.56, 0.20 -> 0.60, 0.19 -> 0.43; muscles with IoU >= 0.6: 1 -> 40 of 91, 3 -> 41 of 94, 2 -> 49 of 98, 5 -> 22 of 102. So most tissue offsets of the reconstructed models ARE pose; volume ratios (176 / 147 / 41 / 60 pairs outside 0.8-1.25) stay anatomical, a residual of shape / position remains (data, thin structures).
- **PART 2 -- Pose panel.** Toolbar button 'Pose' (bottom sheet <= 900 px): per joint one slider + numeric input per DOF and side, hard bounds = normal ROM (AAOS / AMA-style averages quoted from memory, assumptions marked; `docs/pose_rom_table.md`, generated from `scripts/anatomy/q241/rom.py`), shaded normal band, tick = model pose, line = 0; groups Shoulder, Elbow / forearm, Wrist / hand, Thumb, Fingers (MCP/PIP/DIP), Hip, Knee, Ankle / foot (talocrural + subtalar), Toes, Lumbar, Thoracic, Head / neck; presets Reset to model pose, Anatomical position, Symmetric pose R->L / L->R, per-group 'R->L / L->R' mirror buttons, 'Link left and right', Save / Load (localStorage, try/catch). Banner + panel text: 'Pose preview: kinematic approximation, soft tissue not simulated (no collision / volume preservation)'. Mechanics: segments (106 on Base / Combined, 48-49 on Imaging pages) and joints from the page's own bones (`skeleton.py`, `rig.py`: head-sphere fits RMS 0.65-1.0 mm, acetabulum concentricity 4.6 mm, joint centres mirror-consistent to 2 mm on Base); angles of a joint are delta rotations about fixed rest axes (the model pose is reproduced EXACTLY); shoulder = flex / abd / rot relative to the trunk with a scapulohumeral rhythm (clavicle e/12, scapula e/4), patella 0.6 x knee, spine regions split over level joints (shares documented), subtalar axis after Inman. Soft tissue = linear blend skinning (`skin.py`): per-vertex weights from the distance to each segment's bones with smooth falloff, candidate segments restricted so that an arm resting on the abdomen cannot attach to it (name-based skin patch regions, Base-page candidate sets as a prior for the reconstructed pages, island pruning), top-3 influences, mesh smoothing; stored as control vertices (every 6th mixed / 40th pure vertex) + planar deflate, decoded in the browser by inverse-distance interpolation (python and js decoders agree). Embedded per page (base64): Base M 433 KB, Base F 432, Combined M 439, Combined F 464, Imaging M 258, Imaging F 333. BAKED geometry: the posed positions / normals are written back into the engine's own buffers (own: geometry attributes; Z: `gl.bufferSubData` of the moved structures), so picking, Cut clipping, filled cut face (rebuilt after a pose change), selection, labels (anchors recomputed via `labelsCtl.dirty()`), and the Symmetric view follow with no change in the shaders; part markers are hidden while posed; the clinical add-on tools use rest-pose geometry (reset first).
- **Validation** (`validate_pose.py`, every joint DOF to both ends of its normal range, others at the model pose; 190 poses per Z page, 70 per Imaging page; python with the DECODED weights): 'exploding structure' = vertex displacement above the geometric bound of the moved segments. Base M / F: 2 poses of 190 (thumb IP flexion, hand skin +30-36 mm over the bound; everything else within), max vertex drift 377 mm (hand / foot at hip or shoulder extremes, as expected), muscle end drift median 0.02 mm, worst 116 mm (trapezius at shoulder elevation 180); penetration increase vs rest <= 8.6 mm (elbow 150 deg), > 2 mm in 11 / 15 poses. Combined M: 30 poses with structures over the bound (worst: inferior epigastric vessels 167 mm at finger DIP, femoral-triangle skin 132 mm at shoulder abd - arm-on-abdomen / thigh-skin attachments), muscle end drift worst 102 mm, penetration up to 14.2 mm (ankle dorsiflexion). Combined F: 13 poses (superficial epigastric vessels 51 mm, umbilicus skin 37 mm at forearm supination), muscle end drift median 0.02 mm but worst 1.44 m = Z data defect (abductor hallucis R / flexor hallucis brevis L lie between the feet), penetration <= 8.0 mm. Imaging M: 3 poses (hip rotation skin 114 mm, a Z-fill external oblique end drift 1.1 m when the arm is raised = stray vertices of the merged Z-fill mesh follow the arm), penetration <= 8.9 mm. Imaging F: 4 poses (rectus abdominis halves 80-103 mm at forearm supination, end drift 0.69 m), penetration <= 6.3 mm. The reconstructed pages therefore need review of the arm-on-abdomen attachments before they are relied on at extreme angles; the BASIC pages are clean.
- **Browser** (headless Chromium, swiftshader = CPU rasterisation, NOT a GPU): 0 page errors on all six pages; pose update (JS) mean 17-27 ms per DOF end, first use of a joint 100-800 ms (lazy weight decode), 9-170 ms for the 4 screenshot poses; a full-scene software-GL redraw is 1.1-1.5 s here (the same as any orbit step), rest-pose frame cost unchanged. Screenshots `build/q241/_shots/{base_m,comb_f,own_m}_{neutral,elbow_flexed_90,shoulder_abducted_90,hip_flexed_90,knee_flexed_90,panel}.png` and `base_m_phone_*.png` (not committed: build/ is ignored).
- **Limits (honest).** Kinematic approximation: no collision (arms can pass through the trunk), no volume preservation (tissue crumples / stretches near extreme angles; elbow at 150 deg flexion overlaps the olecranon fossa by 8-9 mm, ankle dorsiflexion up to 14 mm on the fitted pages), skin is a coarse skinned surface (tents at the axilla); ROMs are averages quoted from memory; fingers / toes are articulated only where the page has individual bones (Base, Combined; the Imaging pages merge all phalanges / metatarsals into one mesh), thumb CMC is two axes; joint axes are fitted landmarks (errors in `data/derived/Q241_rig_<page>.json`), the subtalar axis is the literature axis; q0 (rest) values outside the range are shown as built (knee -2.7 deg on Base); broken Z meshes (muscle meshes with islands on the other foot) tear under pose. Reconstructed pages: the two arms lie on the abdomen, tissue weights use Base-page candidate sets, residual drifts are listed in the validation files.
- **Open / next.** The Pose panel is not wired into the clinical tools (imaging / ultrasound / needle read rest meshes); markers of the Parts layer are hidden while posed rather than moved; a 'Fit to pose' step (rigid per-segment re-posing of a Z page onto a measured pose) is the natural use of the same rig for the planned fitting of reconstructions onto the Base pages.

## Q240 (2026-10-15) -- VIEW-DEPENDENT PART MARKERS + VESSEL / NERVE LABEL LEVELS (agent; NOT published, hub untouched; pages build/q240/{viewer_m_hr,viewer_f_hr,viewer_zan_vhm,viewer_zan_female,viewer_base_female,viewer_zan_atlas}, regenerated from build/q238 with `scripts/regen_q240.sh`, no geometry recomputed)
Owner (translated): (A) "Origin and insertion points: show only those of muscles that are visible and/or close to the viewer; certainly not those far away, on the other side with a lot of tissue in between, unless specific muscles were marked." (B) "In LABELS: arteries, certainly the main ones, and nerves, should be labelled unless asked otherwise [allow this setting, and up to what size of arteries: also the smaller ones and down to which level; the same for nerves]."
- **(A) Part markers, before / after.** Before: a marker (Q220) was drawn for the selected structure, or for ALL placed parts with the toolbar toggle (all-or-nothing; the dot was depth-tested by the engine but the ring + label showed through the body). Now the toolbar button **Parts markers** opens a panel (`#pm-panel`, in `viewer/parts_ui/`): **Markers** Off / **Visible + near** (default) / Selected only / All, **Depth band** slider (front 10 .. 100 % = all of the visible model depth, default 55 %), **Show hidden ones of selected muscles** (default on). Settings persist per browser (`nmsk.parts.v1`, try / catch).
  - *Visible + near*: a marker is drawn only if (1) not hidden: its view depth (E.project w) is within max(6 mm, 1.2 % of the distance) of the nearest opaque surface in a 3 x 3 pixel neighbourhood of the depth image, OR the surface there is one of the marker's own structures (`car`, the muscle / part mesh; identified in a second low-res ID image, taken only when a marker sits within 45 mm behind a surface) and the marker lies at most 45 mm under it (centre of a Z part mesh, bone under an insertion); (2) within the depth band = nearer than near + band x (far - near) of the VISIBLE depth range (the depth image's own min / max, so it follows layers, isolation, zoom); (3) the Cut mode keeps it (unchanged rule: removed side hidden, slab thickness; the depth pass uses the same clip planes, so a cut muscle shows its own markers on / in the cut face). Layer-off / hidden / isolate / source facet still hide (unchanged).
  - *Exempt*: markers of the selected, MARKED (Selection layer) and HOVERED structures (`partsCtl.hover(id)` from both engines) and of a clicked marker / focused row: always drawn (also far away); when hidden behind tissue they get the see-through style (dashed ring + white halo + ' . behind tissue' on the label; the solid GL dot stays depth-tested). Box off = they are culled like the rest. Cut still hides them.
  - *Engine adaptor additions* (optional members; a page without them keeps the Q220 behaviour = default 'Selected only'): `depthImage(w) -> {w,h,z}` (linear view depth in mm, row 0 top), `idImage(all,w)`, `idOf(meshId)`, `marked()`; plus `partsCtl.hover(id)` / `partsCtl.dirty()` calls next to the labels' ones. Own engine: the labels' flat-colour pass with a `MeshDepthMaterial` (RGBADepthPacking) and the same clip planes (`idImage(all, w, depth)`), decoded to linear depth; Z engine: the existing depth pass (`renderIds(false, true, sc)`) in a corner of the picking buffer (`zDepthImage`), decoded like `pickPoint`. Both pass the same camera / cut / isolation as the screen; only meshes at >= 60 % opacity count as occluders (x-ray / ghost shows what is behind). A GPU without a depth pass (Z needs highp) falls back to Selected only after two failed passes.
  - *Throttle*: markers are re-tested only when the view / cut changes (signature of 4 projected points + cut), on `dirty()` (layer / fade / hide, selection, hover, mode) and never more often than max(0.17 s, 6 x the last pass cost, <= 6 s); during an orbit that is a low-rate refresh, a settle timer takes the last image after the camera stops; a changed set triggers one extra frame (the solid dots). No pass when no marker survives the cut / layer checks.
- **(B) Labels: Vessels & nerves** (Labels panel, `viewer/labels/`): **Hide vessel / nerve labels** (the 'unless asked otherwise' switch); groups **Arteries** (on) / **Veins** (off by default: they were not in the request, one click) / **Nerves** (on); **Artery / vein level** Main / + secondary / + tertiary / All (default + secondary) with **min. diameter** slider 0-20 mm; **Nerve level** Main trunks / + branches / + small / All (default + branches) with **min. diameter** 0-12 mm; help text 'What the levels mean' in the panel, calibre + level on the legend rows. Active in Visible and All (Selected shows what is selected / hovered / marked regardless; those are exempt from the filters).
  - *Levels* (documented in the panel + `data/anatomy/calibre.json`): arteries / veins 1 main >= 6 mm or a named trunk, 2 secondary 3-6, 3 tertiary 1.5-3, 4 small < 1.5; nerves 1 trunk >= 4 mm or a named trunk, 2 branches 2-4, 3 small 1-2, 4 fine < 1. Named trunks (aorta, venae cavae, carotid, subclavian, iliac, femoral, popliteal, brachial; sciatic, tibial, femoral, median, ulnar, radial, musculocutaneous, plexus trunks, cranial nerves ...) are level 1 whatever the mesh calibre (stored as promoted = 1): the meshes are stylised (median nerve ~1.5 mm vs 4-5 mm real).
  - *Priority*: vessels / nerves that pass the filters are ranked level first, then visible length, and get a reserved 40 % of Max labels (min 3; in All the whole budget) so they are not outbid by large muscles; label priority in the callout solver 1 / 0.5 / 0.25 for levels 1 / 2 / >= 3 (main trunks keep their place); the label colour is the structure's own colour (darkened / lightened for contrast, Colour = Structure).
  - *Anchor*: for a vessel / nerve the anchor is the middle part (25-75 %) of the LONGEST visible run along the structure's own main axis in the ID image, the pixel nearest the canvas centre there (`longAnchors`), then the visible surface sample nearest to it; not the centroid of its pixels (which is off a curved / forked structure).
  - *Abbreviations*: no new rules; every vessel / nerve already had BASE[-R|-L] from Q236 (`tests/test_q240_calibre.py` checks uniqueness over all vessels / nerves of the six pages and that no other structure shares one, and the -R / -L suffix).
